translation: Coverdale (Great Bible), as printed in the 1662 Book of Common Prayer

verses.first: BLESSED is the man that hath not walked in the counſel of the ungodly, nor ſtood in the way of ſinners
verses.second: and hath not ſat in the ſeat of the ſcornful;

verses.first: But his delight is in the law of the Lord
verses.second: and in his law will he exerciſe himſelf day and night.

verses.first: And he ſhall be like a tree planted by the water-ſide
verses.second: that will bring forth his fruit in due ſeaſon.

verses.first: His leaf alſo ſhall not wither
verses.second: and look, whatſoever he doeth, it ſhall proſper.

verses.first: As for the ungodly, it is not ſo with them
verses.second: but they are like the chaff, which the wind ſcattereth away from the face of the earth.

verses.first: Therefore the ungodly ſhall not be able to ſtand in the judgment
verses.second: neither the ſinners in the congregation of the righteous.

verses.first: But the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous
verses.second: and the way of the ungodly ſhall periſh.

verses.first: WHY do the heathen ſo furiouſly rage together
verses.second: and why do the people imagine a vain thing?

verses.first: The kings of the earth ſtand up, and the rulers take counſel together
verses.second: againſt the Lord, and againſt his Anointed.

verses.first: Let us break their bonds aſunder
verses.second: and caſt away their cords from us.

verses.first: He that dwelleth in heaven ſhall laugh them to ſcorn
verses.second: the Lord ſhall have them in deriſion.

verses.first: Then ſhall he ſpeak unto them in his wrath
verses.second: and vex them in his ſore diſpleaſure.

verses.first: Yet I have ſet my King
verses.second: upon my holy hill of Sion.

verses.first: I will preach the law, whereof the Lord hath ſaid unto me
verses.second: Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

verses.first: Deſire of me, and I ſhall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance
verses.second: and the utmoſt parts of the earth for thy poſſeſſion.

verses.first: Thou ſhalt bruiſe them with a rod of iron
verses.second: and break them in pieces like a potter’s veſſel.

verses.first: Be wiſe now therefore, O ye kings
verses.second: be learned, ye that are judges of the earth.

verses.first: Serve the Lord in fear
verses.second: and rejoice unto him with reverence.

verses.first: Kiſs the Son, leſt he be angry, and ſo ye periſh from the right way
verses.second: if his wrath be kindled, (yea, but a little,) bleſſed are all they that put their truſt in him.

verses.first: LORD, how are they increaſed that trouble me
verses.second: many are they that riſe againſt me.

verses.first: Many one there be that ſay of my ſoul
verses.second: There is no help for him in his God.

verses.first: But thou, O Lord, art my defender
verses.second: thou art my worſhip, and the lifter up of my head.

verses.first: I did call upon the Lord with my voice
verses.second: and he heard me out of his holy hill.

verses.first: I laid me down and ſlept, and roſe up again
verses.second: for the Lord ſuſtained me.

verses.first: I will not be afraid for ten thouſands of the people
verses.second: that have ſet themſelves againſt me round about.

verses.first: Up, Lord, and help me, O my God
verses.second: for thou ſmiteſt all mine enemies upon the cheekbone; thou haſt broken the teeth of the ungodly.

verses.first: Salvation belongeth unto the Lord
verses.second: and thy bleſſing is upon thy people.

verses.first: HEAR me when I call, O God of my righteouſneſs
verses.second: thou haſt ſet me at liberty when I was in trouble; have mercy upon me, and hearken unto my prayer.

verses.first: O ye ſons of men, how long will ye blaſpheme mine honour
verses.second: and have ſuch pleaſure in vanity, and ſeek after leaſing?

verses.first: Know this alſo, that the Lord hath choſen to himſelf the man that is godly
verses.second: when I call upon the Lord, he will hear me.

verses.first: Stand in awe, and ſin not
verses.second: commune with your own heart, and in your chamber, and be ſtill.

verses.first: Offer the ſacrifice of righteouſneſs
verses.second: and put your truſt in the Lord.

verses.first: There be many that ſay
verses.second: Who will ſhew us any good?

verses.first: Lord, lift thou up
verses.second: the light of thy countenance upon us.

verses.first: Thou haſt put gladneſs in my heart
verses.second: ſince the time that their corn and wine and oil increaſed.

verses.first: I will lay me down in peace, and take my reſt
verses.second: for it is thou, Lord, only, that makeſt me dwell in ſafety.

verses.first: PONDER my words, O Lord
verses.second: conſider my meditation

verses.first: O hearken thou unto the voice of my calling, my King, and my God
verses.second: for unto thee will I make my prayer.

verses.first: My voice ſhalt thou hear betimes, O Lord
verses.second: early in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

verses.first: For thou art the God that haſt no pleaſure in wickedneſs
verses.second: neither ſhall any devil dwell with thee.

verses.first: Such as be fooliſh ſhall not ſtand in thy ſight
verses.second: for thou hateſt all of them that work vanity.

verses.first: Thou ſhalt deſtroy them that ſpeak leaſing
verses.second: the Lord will abhor both the bloodthirſty and deceitful man.

verses.first: But as for me, I will come into thine houſe, even upon the multitude of thy mercy
verses.second: and in thy fear will I worſhip toward thy holy temple.

verses.first: Lead me, O Lord, in thy righteouſneſs, becauſe of mine enemies
verses.second: make thy way plain before my face.

verses.first: For there is no faithfulneſs in his mouth
verses.second: their inward parts are very wickedneſs.

verses.first: Their throat is an open ſepulchre
verses.second: they flatter with their tongue.

verses.first: Deſtroy thou them, O God; let them periſh through their own imaginations
verses.second: caſt them out in the multitude of their ungodlineſs; for they have rebelled againſt thee.

verses.first: And let all them that put their truſt in thee rejoice
verses.second: they ſhall ever be giving of thanks, becauſe thou defendeſt them; they that love thy Name ſhall be joyful in thee;

verses.first: For thou, Lord, wilt give thy bleſſing unto the righteous
verses.second: and with thy favourable kindneſs wilt thou defend him as with a ſhield.

verses.first: O Lord, rebuke me not in thine indignation
verses.second: neither chaſten me in thy diſpleaſure.

verses.first: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am weak
verses.second: O Lord, heal me, for my bones are vexed.

verses.first: My ſoul alſo is ſore troubled
verses.second: but, Lord, how long wilt thou puniſh me?

verses.first: Turn thee, O Lord, and deliver my ſoul
verses.second: O ſave me for thy mercy’s ſake.

verses.first: For in death no man remembereth thee
verses.second: and who will give thee thanks in the pit?

verses.first: I am weary of my groaning; every night waſh I my bed
verses.second: and water my couch with my tears.

verses.first: My beauty is gone for very trouble
verses.second: and worn away becauſe of all mine enemies.

verses.first: Away from me, all ye that work vanity
verses.second: for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.first: The Lord hath heard my petition
verses.second: the Lord will receive my prayer.

verses.first: All mine enemies ſhall be confounded, and ſore vexed
verses.second: they ſhall be turned back, and put to ſhame ſuddenly.

verses.first: O Lord my God, in thee have I put my truſt
verses.second: ſave me from all them that perſecute me, and deliver me;

verses.first: Leſt he devour my ſoul, like a lion, and tear it in pieces
verses.second: while there is none to help.

verses.first: O Lord my God, if I have done any ſuch thing
verses.second: or if there be any wickedneſs in my hands;

verses.first: If I have rewarded evil unto him that dealt friendly with me
verses.second: (yea, I have delivered him that without any cauſe is mine enemy;)

verses.first: Then let mine enemy perſecute my ſoul, and take me
verses.second: yea, let him tread my life down upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the duſt.

verses.first: Stand up, O Lord, in thy wrath, and lift up thyſelf, becauſe of the indignation of mine enemies
verses.second: ariſe up for me in the judgment that thou haſt commanded.

verses.first: And ſo ſhall the congregation of the people come about thee
verses.second: for their ſakes therefore lift up thyſelf again.

verses.first: The Lord ſhall judge the people; give ſentence with me, O Lord
verses.second: according to my righteouſneſs, and according to the innocency that is in me.

verses.first: O let the wickedneſs of the ungodly come to an end
verses.second: but guide thou the juſt.

verses.first: For the righteous God
verses.second: trieth the very hearts and reins.

verses.first: My help cometh of God
verses.second: who preſerveth them that are true of heart.

verses.first: God is a righteous Judge, ſtrong, and patient
verses.second: and God is provoked every day.

verses.first: If a man will not turn, he will whet his ſword
verses.second: he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

verses.first: He hath prepared for him the inſtruments of death
verses.second: he ordaineth his arrows againſt the perſecutors.

verses.first: Behold, he travaileth with miſchief
verses.second: he hath conceived ſorrow, and brought forth ungodlineſs.

verses.first: He hath graven and digged up a pit
verses.second: and is fallen on himſelf into the deſtruction that he made for other.

verses.first: For his travail ſhall come upon his own head
verses.second: and his wickedneſs ſhall fall on his own pate.

verses.first: I will give thanks unto the Lord, according to his righteouſneſs
verses.second: and I will praiſe the Name of the Lord moſt High.

verses.first: O Lord our Governor, how excellent is thy Name in all the world
verses.second: thou haſt ſet thy glory above the heavens!

verses.first: Out of the mouth of very babes and ſucklings haſt thou ordained ſtrength, becauſe of thine enemies
verses.second: that thou mighteſt ſtill the enemy and the avenger.

verses.first: For I will conſider thy heavens, even the works of thy fingers
verses.second: the moon and the ſtars, which thou haſt ordained.

verses.first: What is man, that thou art mindful of him
verses.second: and the ſon of man, that thou viſiteſt him?

verses.first: Thou madeſt him lower than the angels
verses.second: to crown him with glory and worſhip.

verses.first: Thou makeſt him to have dominion of the works of thy hands
verses.second: and thou haſt put all things in ſubjection under his feet;

verses.first: All ſheep and oxen
verses.second: yea, and the beaſts of the field;

verses.first: The fowls of the air, and the fiſhes of the ſea
verses.second: and whatſoever walketh through the paths of the ſeas.

verses.first: O Lord our Governor
verses.second: how excellent is thy Name in all the world!

verses.first: I Will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, with my whole heart
verses.second: I will ſpeak of all thy marvellous works.

verses.first: I will be glad and rejoice in thee
verses.second: yea, my ſongs will I make of thy Name, O thou moſt Higheſt.

verses.first: While mine enemies are driven back
verses.second: they ſhall fall and periſh at thy preſence.

verses.first: For thou haſt maintained my right, and my cauſe
verses.second: thou art ſet in the throne that judgeſt right.

verses.first: Thou haſt rebuked the heathen, and deſtroyed the ungodly
verses.second: thou haſt put out their name for ever and ever.

verses.first: O thou enemy, deſtructions are come to a perpetual end
verses.second: even as the cities which thou haſt deſtroyed; their memorial is periſhed with them.

verses.first: But the Lord ſhall endure for ever
verses.second: he hath alſo prepared his ſeat for judgment.

verses.first: For he ſhall judge the world in righteouſneſs
verses.second: and miniſter true judgment unto the people.

verses.first: The Lord alſo will be a defence for the oppreſſed
verses.second: even a refuge in due time of trouble.

verses.first: And they that know thy Name, will put their truſt in thee
verses.second: for thou, Lord, haſt never failed them that ſeek thee.

verses.first: O praiſe the Lord which dwelleth in Sion
verses.second: ſhew the people of his doings.

verses.first: For when he maketh inquiſition for blood, he remembereth them
verses.second: and forgetteth not the complaint of the poor.

verses.first: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; conſider the trouble which I ſuffer of them that hate me
verses.second: thou that lifteſt me up from the gates of death.

verses.first: That I may ſhew all thy praiſes within the ports of the daughter of Sion
verses.second: I will rejoice in thy ſalvation.

verses.first: The heathen are ſunk down in the pit that they made
verses.second: in the ſame net which they hid privily, is their foot taken.

verses.first: The Lord is known to execute judgment
verses.second: the ungodly is trapped in the work of his own hands.

verses.first: The wicked ſhall be turned into hell
verses.second: and all the people that forget God.

verses.first: For the poor ſhall not always be forgotten
verses.second: the patient abiding of the meek ſhall not periſh for ever.

verses.first: Up, Lord, and let not man have the upper hand
verses.second: let the heathen be judged in thy ſight.

verses.first: Put them in fear, O Lord
verses.second: that the heathen may know themſelves to be but men.

verses.first: WHY ſtandeſt thou ſo far off, O Lord
verses.second: and hideſt thy face in the needful time of trouble?

verses.first: The ungodly for his own luſt doth perſecute the poor
verses.second: let them be taken in the crafty wilineſs that they have imagined.

verses.first: For the ungodly hath made boaſt of his own heart's deſire
verses.second: and ſpeaketh good of the covetous, whom God abhorreth.

verses.text: The ungodly is ſo proud, that he careth not for God; neither is God in all his thoughts.

verses.first: His ways are always grievous
verses.second: thy judgments are far above out of his ſight, and therefore defieth he all his enemies.

verses.first: For he hath ſaid in his heart, Tuſh, I ſhall never be caſt down
verses.second: there ſhall no harm happen unto me.

verses.first: His mouth is full of curſing, deceit, and fraud
verses.second: under his tongue is ungodlineſs and vanity.

verses.first: He ſitteth lurking in the thieviſh corners of the ſtreets
verses.second: and privily in his lurking dens doth he murder the innocent; his eyes are ſet againſt the poor.

verses.first: For he lieth waiting ſecretly, even as a lion lurketh he in his den
verses.second: that he may raviſh the poor.

verses.first: He doth raviſh the poor
verses.second: when he getteth him into his net.

verses.first: He falleth down, and humbleth himſelf
verses.second: that the congregation of the poor may fall into the hands of his captains.

verses.first: He hath ſaid in his heart, Tuſh, God hath forgotten
verses.second: he hideth away his face, and he will never ſee it.

verses.first: Ariſe, O Lord God, and lift up thine hand
verses.second: forget not the poor.

verses.first: Wherefore ſhould the wicked blaſpheme God
verses.second: while he doth ſay in his heart, Tuſh, thou God careſt not for it.

verses.first: Surely thou haſt ſeen it
verses.second: for thou beholdeſt ungodlineſs and wrong.

verses.first: That thou mayeſt take the matter into thy hand
verses.second: the poor committeth himſelf unto thee; for thou art the helper of the friendleſs.

verses.first: Break thou the power of the ungodly and malicious
verses.second: take away his ungodlineſs, and thou ſhalt find none.

verses.first: The Lord is King for ever and ever
verses.second: and the heathen are periſhed out of the land.

verses.first: Lord, thou haſt heard the deſire of the poor
verses.second: thou prepareſt their heart, and thine ear hearkeneth thereto;

verses.first: To help the fatherleſs and poor unto their right
verses.second: that the man of the earth be no more exalted againſt them.

verses.first: IN the Lord put I my truſt
verses.second: how ſay ye then to my ſoul, that ſhe ſhould flee as a bird unto the hill?

verses.first: For lo, the ungodly bend their bow, and make ready their arrows within the quiver
verses.second: that they may privily ſhoot at them which are true of heart.

verses.first: For the foundations will be caſt down
verses.second: and what have the righteous done?

verses.first: The Lord is in his holy temple
verses.second: the Lord’s ſeat is in heaven.

verses.first: His eyes conſider the poor
verses.second: and his eyelids try the children of men.

verses.first: The Lord alloweth the righteous
verses.second: but the ungodly, and him that delighteth in wickedneſs, doth his ſoul abhor.

verses.first: Upon the ungodly he ſhall rain ſnares, fire and brimſtone, ſtorm and tempeſt
verses.second: this ſhall be their portion to drink.

verses.first: For the righteous Lord loveth righteouſneſs
verses.second: his countenance will behold the thing that is juſt.

verses.first: HELP me, Lord, for there is not one godly man left
verses.second: for the faithful are mini ſhed from among the children of men.

verses.first: They talk of vanity every one with his neighbour
verses.second: they do but flatter with their lips, and diſſemble in their double heart.

verses.first: The Lord ſhall root out all deceitful lips
verses.second: and the tongue that ſpeaketh proud things;

verses.first: Which have ſaid, With our tongue will we prevail
verses.second: we are they that ought to ſpeak; Who is lord over us?

verses.first: Now for the comfortleſs trouble's ſake of the needy
verses.second: and becauſe of the deep ſighing of the poor;

verses.first: I will up, ſaith the Lord
verses.second: and will help every one from him that ſwelleth againſt him, and will ſet him at reſt.

verses.first: The words of the Lord are pure words
verses.second: even as the ſilver, which from the earth is tried, and purified ſeven times in the fire.

verses.first: Thou ſhalt keep them, O Lord
verses.second: thou ſhalt preſerve him from this generation for ever.

verses.first: The ungodly walk on every ſide
verses.second: when they are exalted, the children of men are put to rebuke.

verses.first: HUſque quo, Domine? O W long wilt thou forget me, O Lord, for ever
verses.second: how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

verses.first: How long ſhall I ſeek counſel in my ſoul, and be ſo vexed in my heart
verses.second: how long ſhall mine enemies triumph over me?

verses.first: Conſider, and hear me, O Lord my God
verses.second: lighten mine eyes, that I ſleep not in death.

verses.first: Leſt mine enemy ſay, I have prevailed againſt him
verses.second: for if I be caſt down, they that trouble me will rejoice at it.

verses.first: But my truſt is in thy mercy
verses.second: and my heart is joyful in thy ſalvation.

verses.first: I will ſing of the Lord, becauſe he hath dealt ſo lovingly with me
verses.second: yea, I will praiſe the Name of the Lord moſt Higheſt.

verses.first: THE fool hath ſaid in his heart
verses.second: There is no God.

verses.first: They are corrupt, and become abominable in their doings
verses.second: there is none that doeth good, no not one.

verses.first: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the children of men
verses.second: to ſee if there were any that would underſtand, and ſeek after God.

verses.first: But they are all gone out of the way, they are altogether become abominable
verses.second: there is none that doeth good, no not one.

verses.first: Their throat is an open ſepulchre; with their tongues have they deceived
verses.second: the poiſon of aſps is under their lips.

verses.first: Their mouth is full of curſing and bitterneſs
verses.second: their feet are ſwift to ſhed blood.

verses.text: Deſtruction and unhappineſs is in their ways, and the way of peace have they not known; there is no fear of God before their eyes.

verses.first: Have they no knowledge, that they are all ſuch workers of miſchief
verses.second: eating up my people as it were bread, and call not upon the Lord?

verses.first: There were they brought in great fear, even where no fear was
verses.second: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

verses.first: As for you, ye have made a mock at the counſel of the poor
verses.second: becauſe he putteth his truſt in the Lord.

verses.first: Who ſhall give ſalvation unto Iſrael out of Sion? When the Lord turneth the captivity of his people
verses.second: then ſhall Jacob rejoice, and Iſrael ſhall be glad.

verses.first: LORD, who ſhall dwell in thy tabernacle
verses.second: or who ſhall reſt upon thy holy hill?

verses.first: Even he that leadeth an uncorrupt life
verses.second: and doeth the thing which is right, and ſpeaketh the truth from his heart.

verses.first: He that hath uſed no deceit in his tongue, nor done evil to his neighbour
verses.second: and hath not ſlandered his neighbour.

verses.first: He that ſetteth not by himſelf, but is lowly in his own eyes
verses.second: and maketh much of them that fear the Lord.

verses.first: He that ſweareth unto his neighbour, and diſappointeth him not
verses.second: thou it were to his own hindrance.

verses.first: He that hath not given his money upon uſury
verses.second: nor taken reward againſt the innocent.

verses.first: Who ſo doeth theſe things
verses.second: ſhall never fall.

verses.first: PRESERVE me, O God
verses.second: for in thee have I put my truſt.

verses.first: O my ſoul, thou haſt ſaid unto the Lord
verses.second: Thou art my God; my goods are nothing unto thee.

verses.first: All my delight is upon the ſaints, that are in the earth
verses.second: and upon ſuch as excel in virtue.

verses.first: But they that run after another god
verses.second: ſhall have great trouble.

verses.first: Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer
verses.second: neither make mention of their names within my lips.

verses.first: The Lord himſelf is the portion of mine inheritance, and of my cup
verses.second: thou ſhalt maintain my lot.

verses.first: The lot is fallen unto me in a fair ground
verses.second: yea, I have a goodly heritage.

verses.first: I will thank the Lord for giving me warning
verses.second: my reins alſo chaſten me in the nightſeaſon.

verses.first: I have ſet God always before me
verses.second: for he is on my right hand, therefore I ſhall not fall.

verses.first: Wherefore my heart was glad, and my glory rejoiced
verses.second: my fleſh alſo ſhall reſt in hope.

verses.first: For why? thou ſhalt not leave my ſoul in hell
verses.second: neither ſhalt thou ſuffer thy Holy One to ſee corruption.

verses.first: Thou ſhalt ſhew me the path of life; in thy preſence is the fulneſs of joy
verses.second: and at thy right hand there is pleaſure for evermore.

verses.first: HEAR the right, O Lord, conſider my complaint
verses.second: and hearken unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

verses.first: Let my ſentence come forth from thy preſence
verses.second: and let thine eyes look upon the thing that is equal.

verses.text: Thou haſt proved and viſited mine heart in the nightſeaſon; thou haſt tried me, and ſhalt find no wickedneſs in me; for I am utterly purpoſed that my mouth ſhall not offend.

verses.first: Becauſe of men’s works, that are done againſt the words of thy lips
verses.second: I have kept me from the ways of the deſtroyer.

verses.first: O hold thou up my goings in thy paths
verses.second: that my footſteps ſlip not.

verses.first: I have called upon thee, O God, for thou ſhalt hear me
verses.second: incline thine ear to me, and hearken unto my words.

verses.first: Shew thy marvellous loving-kindneſs, thou that art the Saviour of them which put their truſt in thee
verses.second: from ſuch as reſiſt thy right hand.

verses.first: Keep me as the apple of an eye
verses.second: hide me under the ſhadow of thy wings,

verses.first: From the ungodly that trouble me
verses.second: mine enemies compaſs me round about to take away my ſoul.

verses.first: They are incloſed in their own fat
verses.second: and their mouth ſpeaketh proud things.

verses.first: They lie waiting in our way on every ſide
verses.second: turning their eyes down to the ground;

verses.first: Like of a lion that is greedy of his prey
verses.second: and as it were a lion's whelp. lurking in ſecret places.

verses.first: Up, Lord, diſappoint him, and caſt him down
verses.second: deliver my ſoul from the ungodly, which is a ſword of thine;

verses.first: From the men of thy hand, O Lord, from the men, I ſay, and from the evil world
verses.second: which have their portion in this life, whoſe bellies thou filleſt with thy hid treaſure.

verses.first: They have children at their deſire
verses.second: and leave the reſt of their ſubſtance for their babes.

verses.first: But as for me, I will behold thy preſence in righteouſneſs
verses.second: and when I awake up after thy likeneſs, I ſhall be ſatiſfied with it.

verses.first: I Will love thee, O Lord, my ſtrength; the Lord is my ſtony rock, and my defence
verses.second: my Saviour, my God, and my might, in whom I will truſt; my buckler, the horn alſo of my ſalvation, and my refuge.

verses.first: I will call upon the Lord, which is worthy to be praiſed
verses.second: ſo ſhall I be ſafe from mine enemies.

verses.first: The ſorrows of death compaſſed me
verses.second: and the overflowings of ungodlineſs made me afraid.

verses.first: The pains of hell came about me
verses.second: the ſnares of death overtook me.

verses.first: In my trouble I will call upon the Lord
verses.second: and complain unto my God. I

verses.first: So ſhall he hear my voice out of his holy temple
verses.second: and my complaint ſhall come before him, it ſhall enter even into his ears.

verses.first: The earth trembled and quaked
verses.second: the very foundations alſo of the hills ſhook, and were removed, becauſe he was wroth.

verses.first: There went a ſmoke out in his preſence
verses.second: and a conſuming fire out of his mouth, ſo that coals were kindled at it.

verses.first: He bowed the heavens alſo, and came down
verses.second: and it was dark under his feet.

verses.first: He rode upon the cherubins, and did fly
verses.second: he came flying upon the wings of the wind.

verses.first: He made darkneſs his ſecret place
verses.second: his pavilion round about him, with dark water, and thick clouds to cover him.

verses.first: At the brightneſs of his preſence his clouds removed
verses.second: hailſtones, and coals of fire.

verses.first: The Lord alſo thundered out of heaven, and the Higheſt gave his thunder
verses.second: hailſtones, and coals of fire.

verses.first: He ſent out his arrows, and ſcattered them
verses.second: he caſt forth lightnings, and deſtroyed them.

verses.first: The ſprings of water were ſeen, and the foundations of the round world were diſcovered at thy chiding, O Lord
verses.second: at the blaſting of the breath of thy diſpleaſure.

verses.first: He ſhall ſend down from on high to fetch me
verses.second: and ſhall take me out of many waters.

verses.first: He ſhall deliver from me my ſtrongeſt enemy, and from them which hate me
verses.second: for they are too mighty for me.

verses.first: They prevented me in the day of my trouble
verses.second: but the Lord was my upholder.

verses.first: He brought me forth alſo into a place of liberty
verses.second: he brought me forth, even becauſe he had a favour unto me.

verses.first: The Lord ſhall reward me after my righteous dealing
verses.second: according to the cleanneſs of my hands ſhall he recompenſe me.

verses.first: Becauſe I have kept the ways of the Lord
verses.second: and have not forſaken my God, as the wicked doth.

verses.first: For I have an eye unto all his laws
verses.second: and will not caſt out his commandments from me.

verses.first: I was alſo uncorrupt before him
verses.second: and eſchewed mine own wickedneſs.

verses.first: Therefore ſhall the Lord reward me after my righteous dealing
verses.second: and according unto the cleanneſs of my hands in his eyeſight.

verses.first: With the holy thou ſhalt be holy
verses.second: and with a perfect man thou ſhalt be perfect.

verses.first: With the clean thou ſhalt be clean
verses.second: and with the froward thou ſhalt learn frowardneſs.

verses.first: For thou ſhalt ſave the people that are in adverſity
verses.second: and ſhalt bring down the high looks of the proud.

verses.first: Thou alſo ſhalt light my candle
verses.second: the Lord my God ſhall make my darkneſs to be light.

verses.first: For in thee I ſhall diſcomfit an hoſt of men
verses.second: and with the help of my God I ſhall leap over the wall.

verses.first: The way of God is an undefiled way
verses.second: the word of the Lord alſo is tried in the fire; he is the defender of all them that put their truſt in him.

verses.first: For who is God, but the Lord
verses.second: or who hath any ſtrength, except our God?

verses.first: It is God, that girdeth me with ſtrength of war
verses.second: and maketh my way perfect.

verses.first: He maketh my feet like harts feet
verses.second: and ſetteth me up on high.

verses.first: He teacheth mine hands to fight
verses.second: and mine arms ſhall break even a bow of ſteel.

verses.first: Thou haſt given me the defence of my ſalvation
verses.second: thy right hand alſo ſhall hold me up, and thy loving correction ſhall make me great.

verses.first: Thou ſhalt make room enough under me for to go
verses.second: that my footſteps ſhall not ſlide.

verses.first: I will follow upon mine enemies, and overtake them
verses.second: neither will I turn again till I have deſtroyed them.

verses.first: I will ſmite them, that they ſhall not be able to ſtand
verses.second: but fall under my feet.

verses.first: Thou haſt girded me with ſtrength unto the battle
verses.second: thou ſhalt throw done mine enemies under me.

verses.first: Thou haſt made mine enemies alſo to turn their backs upon me
verses.second: and I ſhall deſtroy them that hate me.

verses.first: They ſhall cry, but there ſhall be none to help them
verses.second: yea, even unto the Lord ſhall they cry, but he ſhall not hear them.

verses.first: I will beat them as ſmall as the duſt before the wind
verses.second: I will caſt them out as the clay in the ſtreets.

verses.first: Thou ſhalt deliver me from the ſtrivings of the people
verses.second: and thou ſhalt make me the head of the heathen.

verses.first: A people whom I have not known
verses.second: ſhall ſerve me.

verses.first: As ſoon as they hear of me, they ſhall obey me
verses.second: but the ſtrange children ſhall diſſemble with me.

verses.first: The ſtrange children ſhall fail
verses.second: and be afraid out of their priſons.

verses.first: The Lord liveth, and bleſſed be my ſtrong helper
verses.second: and praiſed be the Lord of my ſalvation;

verses.first: Even the God that ſeeth that I be avenged
verses.second: and ſubdueth the people unto me.

verses.first: It is he that delivereth me from my cruel enemies, and ſetteth me up above mine adverſaries
verses.second: thou ſhalt rid me from the wicked man.

verses.first: For this cauſe will I give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the Gentiles
verses.second: and ſing praiſes unto thy Name.

verses.first: Great proſperity giveth he unto his King
verses.second: and ſheweth loving-kindneſs unto David his Anointed, and unto his ſeed for evermore.

verses.first: THE heavens declare the glory of God
verses.second: and the firmament ſheweth his handywork.

verses.first: One day telleth another
verses.second: and one night certifieth another.

verses.first: There is neither ſpeech nor language
verses.second: but their voices are heard among them.

verses.first: Their sound is gone out into all lands
verses.second: and their words into the ends of the world.

verses.first: In them hath he set a tabernacle for the ſun
verses.second: which cometh forth as a bridegroom out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a giant to run his courſe.

verses.first: It goeth forth from the uttermoſt part of the heaven, and runneth about unto the end of it again
verses.second: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

verses.first: The law of the Lord is an undefiled law, converting the soul
verses.second: the teſtimony of the Lord is ſure, and giveth wiſdom unto the ſimple.

verses.first: The ſtatutes of the Lord are right, and rejoice the heart
verses.second: the commandment of the Lord is pure, and giveth light unto the eyes.

verses.first: The fear of the Lord is clean, and endureth for ever
verses.second: the judgments of the Lord are true, and righteous altogether.

verses.first: More to be deſired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold
verses.second: ſweeter alſo than honey, and the honey-comb.

verses.first: Moreover, by them is thy ſervant taught
verses.second: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

verses.first: Who can tell how oft he offendeth
verses.second: O cleanſe thou me from my ſecret faults.

verses.first: Keep thy ſervant alſo from preſumptuous ſins, leſt they get the dominion over me
verses.second: ſo ſhall I be undefiled, and innocent from the great offence.

verses.first: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditations of my heart
verses.second: be alway acceptable in thy ſight,

verses.first: O Lord
verses.second: my ſtrength, and my redeemer.

verses.first: THE Lord hear thee in the day of trouble
verses.second: the Name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

verses.first: Send thee help from the ſanctuary
verses.second: and ſtrengthen thee out of Sion;

verses.first: Remember all thy offerings
verses.second: and accept thy burnt ſacrifice;

verses.first: Grant thee thy heart's deſire
verses.second: and fulfil all thy mind.

verses.first: We will rejoice in thy ſalvation, and triumph in the Name of the Lord our God
verses.second: the Lord perform all thy petitions.

verses.first: Now know I that the Lord helpeth his Anointed, and will hear him from his holy heaven
verses.second: even with the wholeſome ſtrength of his right hand.

verses.first: Some put their truſt in chariots, and ſome in horſes
verses.second: but we will remember the Name of the Lord our God.

verses.first: They are brought down, and fallen
verses.second: but we are riſen, and ſtand upright.

verses.first: Save, Lord and hear us, O King of heaven
verses.second: when we call upon thee.

verses.first: THE King ſhall rejoice in thy ſtrength, O Lord
verses.second: exceeding glad ſhall he be of thy ſalvation.

verses.first: Thou haſt given him his heart’s deſire
verses.second: and haſt not denied him the requeſt of his lips.

verses.first: For thou ſhalt prevent him with the bleſſings of goodneſs
verses.second: and ſhalt ſet a crown of pure gold upon his head.

verses.first: He aſked life of thee, and thou gaveſt him a long life
verses.second: even for ever and ever.

verses.first: His honour is great in thy ſalvation
verses.second: glory and great worſhip ſhalt thou lay upon him.

verses.first: For thou ſhalt give him everlaſting felicity
verses.second: and make him glad with the joy of thy countenance.

verses.first: And why? becauſe the King putteth his truſt in the Lord
verses.second: and in the mercy of the moſt Higheſt he ſhall not miſcarry.

verses.first: All thine enemies ſhall feel thine hand
verses.second: thy right hand ſhall find out them that hate thee.

verses.first: Thou ſhalt make them like a fiery oven in time of thy wrath
verses.second: the Lord ſhall deſtroy them in his diſpleaſure, and the fire ſhall conſume them.

verses.first: Their fruit ſhalt thou root out of the earth
verses.second: and their ſeed from among the children of men.

verses.first: For they intended miſchief againſt thee
verses.second: and imagined ſuch a device as they are not able to perform.

verses.first: Therefore ſhalt thou put them to flight
verses.second: and the ſtrings of thy bow ſhalt thou make ready againſt the face of them.

verses.first: Be thou exalted, Lord, in thine own ſtrength
verses.second: ſo we will ſing, and praiſe thy power.

verses.first: MY God, my God, look upon me; why haſt thou forſaken me
verses.second: and art ſo far from my health, and from the words of my complaint?

verses.first: O my God, I cry in the day-time, but thou heareſt not
verses.second: and in the nightſeaſon alſo I take no reſt.

verses.first: And thou continueſt holy
verses.second: O thou worſhip of Iſrael.

verses.first: Our fathers hoped in thee
verses.second: they truſted in thee, and thou didſt deliver them.

verses.first: They called upon thee, and were holpen
verses.second: they put their truſt in thee, and were not confounded.

verses.first: But as for me, I am a worm, and no man
verses.second: a very ſcorn of men, and the outcaſt of the people.

verses.first: All they that ſee me laugh me to ſcorn
verses.second: they ſhoot our their lips, and ſhake their heads, ſaying,

verses.first: He truſted in God, that he would deliver him
verses.second: let him deliver him, if he will have him.

verses.first: But thou art he that took me out of my mother’s womb
verses.second: thou waſt my hope, when I hanged yet upon my mother’s breaſts.

verses.first: I have been left unto thee ever ſince I was born
verses.second: thou art my God, even from my mother’s womb.

verses.first: O go not from me, for trouble is hard at hand
verses.second: and there is none to help me.

verses.first: Many oxen are come about me
verses.second: fat bulls of Baſan cloſe me in on every ſide.

verses.first: They gape upon me with their mouths
verses.second: as it were a ramping and a roaring lion.

verses.first: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint
verses.second: my heart alſo in the midſt of my body is even like melting wax.

verses.first: My ſtrength is dried up like a potſherd, and my tongue cleaveth to my gums
verses.second: and thou ſhalt bring me into the duſt of death.

verses.first: For many dogs are come about me
verses.second: and the council of the wicked layeth ſiege againſt me.

verses.first: They pierced my hands and my feet; I may tell all my bones
verses.second: they ſtand ſtaring and looking upon me.

verses.first: They part my garments among them
verses.second: and caſts lots upon my veſture.

verses.first: But be not thou far from me, O Lord
verses.second: thou art my ſuccour; haſte thee to help me.

verses.first: Deliver my ſoul from the ſword
verses.second: my darling from the power of the dog.

verses.first: Save me from the lion’s mouth
verses.second: thou haſt heard me alſo from among the horns of the unicorns.

verses.first: I will declare thy Name unto my brethren
verses.second: in the midſt of the congregation will I praiſe thee.

verses.first: O praiſe the Lord, ye that fear him
verses.second: magnify him, all ye of the ſeed of Jacob, and fear him, all ye ſeed of Iſrael.

verses.first: For he hath not deſpiſed, nor abhorred, the low eſtate of the poor
verses.second: he hath not hid his face from him, but when he called unto him he heard him.

verses.first: My praiſe is of thee in the great congregation
verses.second: my vows will I perform in the ſight of them that fear him.

verses.first: The poor ſhall eat and be ſatiſfied
verses.second: they that ſeek after the Lord ſhall praiſe him; your heart ſhall live for ever.

verses.first: All the ends of the world ſhall remember themſelves, and be turned unto the Lord
verses.second: and all the kindreds of the nations ſhall worſhip before him.

verses.first: For the kingdom is the Lord’s
verses.second: and he is the Governor among the people.

verses.first: All ſuch as be fat upon earth
verses.second: have eaten and worſhipped.

verses.first: All they that go down into the duſt ſhall kneel before him
verses.second: and no man hath quickened his own ſoul.

verses.first: My ſeed ſhall ſerve him
verses.second: they ſhall be counted unto the Lord for a generation.

verses.first: They ſhall come, and the heavens ſhall declare his righteouſneſs
verses.second: unto a people that ſhall be born, whom the Lord hath made.

verses.first: THE Lord is my ſhepherd
verses.second: therefore can I lack nothing.

verses.first: He ſhall feed me in a green paſture
verses.second: and lead me forth beſide the waters of comfort.

verses.first: He ſhall convert my ſoul
verses.second: and bring me forth in the paths of righteouſneſs, for his Name’s ſake.

verses.first: Yea, thou I walk through the valley of the ſhadow of death, I will fear no evil
verses.second: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy ſtaff comfort me.

verses.first: Thou ſhalt prepare a table before me againſt them that trouble me
verses.second: thou haſt anointed my head with oil, and my cup ſhall be full.

verses.first: But thy loving-kindneſs and mercy ſhall follow me all the days of my life
verses.second: and I will dwell in the houſe of the Lord for ever.

verses.first: THE earth is the Lord’s, and all that therein is
verses.second: the compaſs of the world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.first: For he hath founded it upon the ſeas
verses.second: and prepared it upon the floods.

verses.first: Who ſhall aſcend into the hill of the Lord
verses.second: or who ſhall riſe up in his holy place?

verses.first: Even he that hath clean hands, and a pure heart
verses.second: and that hath not lift up his mind unto vanity, nor ſworn to deceive his neighbour.

verses.first: He ſhall receive the bleſſing from the Lord
verses.second: and righteouſneſs from the God of his ſalvation.

verses.first: This is the generation of them that ſeek him
verses.second: even of them that ſeek thy face, O Jacob.

verses.first: Lift up your heads, O ye gates, and be ye lift up, ye everlaſting doors
verses.second: and the King of glory ſhall come in.

verses.first: Who is the King of glory
verses.second: it is the Lord, ſtrong and mighty, even the Lord mighty in battle.

verses.first: Lift up your heads, O ye gates, and be ye lift up, ye everlaſting doors
verses.second: and the King of glory ſhall come in.

verses.first: Who is the King of glory
verses.second: even the Lord of hoſts, he is the King of glory.

verses.first: UNTO thee, O Lord, will I lift up my ſoul; my God, I have put my truſt in thee
verses.second: O let me not be confounded, neither let mine enemies triumph over me.

verses.first: For all they that hope in thee ſhall not be aſhamed
verses.second: but ſuch as tranſgreſs without a cauſe ſhall be put to confuſion.

verses.first: Shew me thy ways, O Lord
verses.second: and teach me thy paths.

verses.first: Lead me forth in thy truth, and learn me
verses.second: for thou art the God of my ſalvation; in thee hath been my hope all the day long.

verses.first: Call to remembrance, O Lord, thy tender mercies
verses.second: and thy loving-kindneſſes, which have been ever of old.

verses.first: O remember not the ſins and offences of my youth
verses.second: but according to thy mercy think thou upon me, O Lord, for thy goodneſs.

verses.first: Gracious and righteous is the Lord
verses.second: therefore will he teach ſinners in the way.

verses.first: Them that are meek ſhall he guide in judgment
verses.second: and ſuch as are gentle, them ſhall he learn his way.

verses.first: All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth
verses.second: unto ſuch as keep his covenant and his teſtimonies.

verses.first: For thy Name’s ſake, O Lord
verses.second: be merciful unto my ſin, for it is great.

verses.first: What man is he that feareth the Lord
verses.second: him ſhall he teach in the way that he ſhall chooſe.

verses.first: His ſoul ſhall dwell at eaſe
verses.second: and his ſeed ſhall inherit the land.

verses.first: The ſecret of the Lord is among them that fear him
verses.second: and he will ſhew them his covenant.

verses.first: Mine eyes are ever looking unto the Lord
verses.second: for he ſhall pluck my feet out of the net.

verses.first: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me
verses.second: for I am deſolate and in miſery.

verses.first: The ſorrows of my heart are enlarged
verses.second: O bring thou me out of my troubles.

verses.first: Look upon my adverſity and miſery
verses.second: and forgive me all my ſin.

verses.first: Conſider mine enemies, how many they are
verses.second: and they bear a tyrannous hate againſt me.

verses.first: O keep my ſoul, and deliver me
verses.second: let me not be confounded, for I have put my truſt in thee.

verses.first: Let perfectneſs and righteous dealing wait upon me
verses.second: for my hope hath been in thee.

verses.first: Deliver Iſrael, O God
verses.second: out of all his troubles.

verses.first: BE thou my judge, O Lord, for I have walked innocently
verses.second: my truſt hath been alſo in the Lord, therefore ſhall I not fall.

verses.first: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me
verses.second: try out my reins and my heart.

verses.first: For thy loving-kindneſs is ever before mine eyes
verses.second: and I will walk in thy truth.

verses.first: I have not dwelt with vain perſons
verses.second: neither will I have fellowſhip with the deceitful.

verses.first: I have hated the congregation of the wicked
verses.second: and will not ſit among the ungodly.

verses.first: I will waſh my hands in innocency, O Lord
verses.second: and ſo will I go to thine altar.

verses.first: That I may ſhew the voice of thankſgiving
verses.second: and tell of all thy wondrous works.

verses.first: Lord, I have loved the habitation of thy houſe
verses.second: and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

verses.first: O ſhut not up my ſoul with the ſinners
verses.second: nor my life with the blood-thirſty.

verses.first: In whoſe hands is wickedneſs
verses.second: and their right hand is full of gifts.

verses.first: But as for me, I will walk innocently
verses.second: O deliver me, and be merciful unto me.

verses.first: My foot ſtandeth right
verses.second: I will praiſe the Lord in the congregations.

verses.first: THE Lord is my light and my ſalvation; whom then ſhall I fear
verses.second: the Lord is the ſtrength of my life; of whom then ſhall I be afraid?

verses.first: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my fleſh
verses.second: they ſtumbled, and fell.

verses.first: Though an hoſt of men were laid againſt me, yet ſhall not my heart be afraid
verses.second: and though there roſe up war againſt me, yet will I put my truſt in him.

verses.first: One thing have I deſired of the Lord, which I will require
verses.second: even that I may dwell in the houſe of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the fair beauty of the Lord, and to viſit his temple.

verses.first: For in the time of trouble he ſhall hide me in his tabernacle
verses.second: yea, in the ſecret place of his dwelling ſhall he hide me, and ſet me up upon a rock of ſtone.

verses.first: And now ſhall he lift up mine head
verses.second: above mine enemies round about me.

verses.first: Therefore will I offer in his dwelling an oblation with great gladneſs
verses.second: I will ſing, and ſpeak praiſes unto the Lord.

verses.first: Hearken unto my voice, O Lord, when I cry unto thee
verses.second: have mercy upon me, and hear me.

verses.first: My heart hath talked of thee, Seek ye my face
verses.second: Thy face, Lord, will I ſeek.

verses.first: O hide not thou thy face from me
verses.second: nor caſt thy ſervant away in diſpleaſure.

verses.first: Thou haſt been my ſuccour
verses.second: leave me not, neither forſake me, O God of my ſalvation.

verses.first: When my father and my mother forſake me
verses.second: the Lord taketh me up.

verses.first: Teach me thy way, O Lord
verses.second: and lead me in the right way, becauſe of mine enemies.

verses.first: Deliver me not over into the will of mine adverſaries
verses.second: for there are falſe witneſſes riſen up againſt me, and ſuch as ſpeak wrong.

verses.first: I ſhould utterly have fainted
verses.second: but that I believe verily to ſee the goodneſs of the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.first: O tarry thou the Lord’s leiſure
verses.second: be ſtrong, and he ſhall comfort thine heart; and put thou thy truſt in the Lord.

verses.first: UNTO thee will I cry, O Lord my ſtrength
verses.second: think no ſcorn of me; leſt if thou make as though thou heareſt not, I become like them that go down into the pit.

verses.first: Hear the voice of my humble petitions, when I cry unto thee
verses.second: when I hold up my hands towards the mercyſeat of thy holy temple.

verses.first: O pluck me not away, neither deſtroy me, with the ungodly and wicked doers
verses.second: which ſpeak friendly to their neighbours, but imagine miſchief in their hearts.

verses.first: Reward them according to their deeds
verses.second: and according to the wickedneſs of their own inventions.

verses.first: Recompenſe them after the work of their hands
verses.second: pay them that they have deſerved.

verses.first: For they regard not in their mind the works of the Lord, nor the operation of his hands
verses.second: therefore ſhall he break them down, and not build them up.

verses.first: Praiſed be the Lord
verses.second: for he hath heard the voice of my humble petitions.

verses.first: The Lord is my ſtrength and my ſhield; my heart hath truſted in him, and I am helped
verses.second: therefore my heart danceth for joy, and in my ſong will I praiſe him.

verses.first: The Lord is my ſtrength
verses.second: and he is the wholeſome defence of his Anointed.

verses.first: O ſave thy people, and give thy bleſſing unto thine inheritance
verses.second: feed them, and ſet them up for ever.

verses.first: BRING unto the Lord, O ye mighty, bring young rams unto the Lord
verses.second: aſcribe unto the Lord worſhip and ſtrength.

verses.first: Give the Lord the honour due unto his Name
verses.second: worſhip the Lord with holy worſhip.

verses.first: It is the Lord that commandeth the waters
verses.second: it is the glorious God that maketh the thunder.

verses.first: It is the Lord that ruleth the ſea; the voice of the Lord is mighty in operation
verses.second: the voice of the Lord is a glorious voice.

verses.first: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedartrees
verses.second: yea, the Lord breaketh the cedars of Libanus.

verses.first: He maketh them alſo to ſkip like a calf
verses.second: Libanus alſo, and Sirion, like a young unicorn.

verses.first: The voice of the Lord divideth the flames of fire; the voice of the Lord ſhaketh the wilderneſs
verses.second: yea, the Lord ſhaketh the wilderneſs of Cades.

verses.first: The voice of the Lord maketh the hinds to bring forth young, and diſcovereth the thick buſhes
verses.second: in his temple doth every man ſpeak of his honour.

verses.first: The Lord ſitteth above the water-flood
verses.second: and the Lord remaineth a King for ever.

verses.first: The Lord ſhall give ſtrength unto his people
verses.second: the Lord ſhall give his people the bleſſing of peace.

verses.first: I Will magnify thee, O Lord, for thou haſt ſet me up
verses.second: and not made my foes to triumph over me.

verses.first: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee
verses.second: and thou haſt healed me.

verses.first: Thou, Lord, haſt brought my ſoul out of hell
verses.second: thou haſt kept my life from them that go down to the pit.

verses.first: Sing praiſes unto the Lord, O ye ſaints of his
verses.second: and give thanks unto him for a remembrance of his holineſs.

verses.first: For his wrath endureth but the twinkling of an eye, and in his pleaſure is life
verses.second: heavineſs may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

verses.first: And in my proſperity I ſaid, I ſhall never be removed
verses.second: thou, Lord, of thy goodneſs haſt made my hill ſo ſtrong.

verses.first: Thou didſt turn thy face from me
verses.second: and I was troubled.

verses.first: Then cried I unto thee, O Lord
verses.second: and gat me to my Lord right humbly.

verses.first: What profit is there in my blood
verses.second: when I go down to the pit?

verses.first: Shall the duſt give thanks unto thee
verses.second: or ſhall it declare thy truth?

verses.first: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me
verses.second: Lord, be thou my helper.

verses.first: Thou haſt turned my heavineſs into joy
verses.second: thou haſt put off my ſackcloth, and girded me with gladneſs.

verses.first: Therefore ſhall every good man ſing of thy praiſe without ceaſing
verses.second: O my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

verses.first: IN thee, O Lord, have I put my truſt
verses.second: let me never be put to confuſion; deliver me in thy righteouſneſs.

verses.first: Bow down thine ear to me
verses.second: make haſte to deliver me.

verses.first: And be thou my ſtrong rock, and houſe of defence
verses.second: that thou mayeſt ſave me.

verses.first: For thou art my ſtrong rock, and my caſtle
verses.second: be thou alſo my guide, and lead me for thy Name’s ſake.

verses.first: Draw me out of the net that they have laid privily for me
verses.second: for thou art my ſtrength.

verses.first: Into thy hands I commend my ſpirit
verses.second: for thou haſt redeemed me, O Lord, thou God of truth.

verses.first: I have hated them that hold of ſuperſtitious vanities
verses.second: and my truſt hath been in the Lord.

verses.first: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy
verses.second: for thou haſt conſidered my trouble, and haſt known my ſoul in adverſities.

verses.first: Thou haſt not ſhut me up into the hand of the enemy
verses.second: but haſt ſet my feet in a large room.

verses.first: Have mercy upon me, O Lord , for I am in trouble
verses.second: and mine eye is conſumed for very heavineſs; yea, my ſoul and my body.

verses.first: For my life is waxen old with heavineſs
verses.second: and my years with mourning.

verses.first: My ſtrength faileth me, becauſe of mine iniquity
verses.second: and my bones are conſumed.

verses.first: I became a reproof among all mine enemies, but eſpecially among my neighbours
verses.second: and they of mine acquaintance were afraid of me; and they that did ſee me without, conveyed themſelves from me.

verses.first: I am clean forgotten, as a dead man out of mind
verses.second: I am become like a broken veſſel.

verses.first: For I have heard the blaſphemy of the multitude
verses.second: and fear is on every ſide, while they conſpire together againſt me, and take their counſel to take away my life.

verses.first: But my hope hath been in thee, O Lord
verses.second: I have ſaid, Thou art my God.

verses.first: My time is in thy hand; deliver me from the hand of mine enemies
verses.second: and from them that perſecute me.

verses.first: Shew thy ſervant the light of thy countenance
verses.second: and ſave me for thy mercy’s ſake.

verses.first: Let me not be confounded, O Lord for I have called upon thee
verses.second: let the ungodly be put to confuſion, and be put to ſilence in the grave.

verses.first: Let the lying lips be put to ſilence
verses.second: which cruelly, diſdainfully, and deſpitefully, ſpeak againſt the righteous.

verses.first: O how plentiful is thy goodneſs, which thou haſt laid up for them that fear thee
verses.second: and that thou haſt prepared for them that put their truſt in thee, even before the ſons of men!

verses.first: Thou ſhalt hide them privily by thine own preſence from the provoking of all men
verses.second: thou P S A L M S. The 6. Day. ſhalt keep them ſecretly in thy tabernacle from the ſtrife of tongues.

verses.first: Thanks be to the Lord
verses.second: for he hath ſhewed me marvellous great kindneſs in a ſtrong city.

verses.first: And when I made haſte, I ſaid
verses.second: I am caſt out of the ſight of thine eyes.

verses.first: Nevertheleſs, thou heardeſt the voice of my prayer
verses.second: when I cried unto thee.

verses.first: O love the Lord, all ye his ſaints
verses.second: for the Lord preſerveth them that are faithful, and plenteouſly rewardeth the proud doer.

verses.first: Be ſtrong, and he ſhall eſtabliſh your heart
verses.second: all that ye put your truſt in the Lord.

verses.first: BLESSED is he whoſe unrighteouſneſs is forgiven
verses.second: and whoſe ſin is covered.

verses.first: Bleſſed is the man unto whom the Lord imputeth no ſin
verses.second: and in whoſe ſpirit there is no guile.

verses.first: For while I held my tongue
verses.second: my bones conſumed away through my daily complaining.

verses.first: For thy hand is heavy upon me day and night
verses.second: and my moiſture is like the drought in ſummer.

verses.first: I will acknowledge my ſin unto thee
verses.second: and mine unrighteouſneſs have I not hid.

verses.first: I ſaid, I will confeſs my ſins unto the Lord
verses.second: and ſo thou forgaveſt the wickedneſs of my ſin.

verses.first: For this ſhall every one that is godly make his prayer unto thee, in a time when thou mayeſt be found
verses.second: but in the great water-floods they ſhall not come nigh him.

verses.first: Thou art a place to hide me in, thou ſhalt preſerve me from trouble
verses.second: thou ſhalt compaſs me about with ſongs of deliverance.

verses.first: I will inform thee, and teach thee in the way wherein thou ſhalt go
verses.second: and I will guide thee with mine eyes.

verses.first: Be ye not like to horſe and mule, which have no underſtanding
verses.second: whoſe mouths muſt be held with bit and bridle. leſt they fall upon thee.

verses.first: Great plagues remain for the ungodly
verses.second: but who ſo putteth his truſt in the Lord, mercy embraceth him on every ſide.

verses.first: Be glad, O ye righteous, and rejoice in the Lord
verses.second: and be joyful, all ye that are true of heart.

verses.first: REJOICE in the Lord, O ye righteous
verses.second: for it becometh well the juſt to be thankful.

verses.first: Praiſe the Lord with harp
verses.second: ſing praiſes unto him with the lute, and inſtrument of ten ſtrings.

verses.first: Sing unto the Lord a new ſong
verses.second: ſing praiſes luſtily unto him with a good courage.

verses.first: For the word of the Lord is true
verses.second: and all his works are faithful.

verses.first: He loveth righteouſneſs and judgment
verses.second: the earth is full of the goodneſs of the Lord.

verses.first: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made
verses.second: and all the hoſts of them by the breath of his mouth.

verses.first: He gathereth the waters of the ſea together, as it were upon an heap
verses.second: and layeth up the deep as in a treaſure-houſe.

verses.first: Let all the earth fear the Lord
verses.second: ſtand in awe of him, all ye that dwell in the world;

verses.first: For he ſpake, and it was done
verses.second: he commanded and it ſtood faſt.

verses.first: The Lord bringeth the counſel of the heathen to nought
verses.second: and maketh the devices of the people to be of none effect, and caſteth out the counſels of princes.

verses.first: The counſel of the Lord ſhall endure for ever
verses.second: and the thoughts of his heart from generation to generation.

verses.first: Bleſſed are the people, whoſe God is the Lord Jehovah
verses.second: and bleſſed are the folk that he hath choſen to him to be his inheritance.

verses.first: The Lord looked down from heaven, and beheld all the children of men
verses.second: from the habitation of his dwelling he conſidereth all them that dwell on the earth.

verses.first: He faſhioneth all the hearts of them
verses.second: and underſtandeth all their works.

verses.first: There is no king that can be ſaved by the multitude of an hoſt
verses.second: neither is any mighty man delivered by much ſtrength.

verses.first: A horſe is counted but a vain thing to ſave a man
verses.second: neither ſhall he deliver any man by his great ſtrength.

verses.first: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him
verses.second: and upon them that put their truſt in his mercy;

verses.first: To deliver their ſoul from death
verses.second: and to feed them in the time of dearth.

verses.first: Our ſoul hath patiently tarried for the Lord
verses.second: for he is our help and our ſhield.

verses.first: For our heart ſhall rejoice in him
verses.second: becauſe we have hoped in his holy Name.

verses.first: Let thy merciful kindneſs, O Lord, be upon us
verses.second: like as we do put our truſt in thee.

verses.first: I Will alway give thanks unto the Lord
verses.second: his praiſe ſhall ever be in my mouth.

verses.first: My ſoul ſhall make her boaſt in the Lord
verses.second: the humble ſhall hear thereof, and be glad.

verses.first: O praiſe the Lord with me
verses.second: and let us magnify his Name together.

verses.first: I ſought the Lord, and he heard me
verses.second: yea, he delivered me out of all my fear.

verses.first: They had an eye unto him, and were lightened
verses.second: and their faces were not aſhamed.

verses.first: Lo, the poor crieth, and the Lord heareth him
verses.second: yea, and ſaveth him out of all his troubles.

verses.first: The angel of the Lord tarrieth round about them that fear him
verses.second: and delivereth them.

verses.first: O taſte, and ſee, how gracious the Lord is
verses.second: bleſſed is the man that truſteth in him.

verses.first: O fear the Lord, ye that are his ſaints
verses.second: for they that fear him lack nothing.

verses.first: The lions do lack, and ſuffer hunger
verses.second: but they who ſeek the Lord ſhall want no manner of thing that is good.

verses.first: Come, ye children, and hearken unto me
verses.second: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

verses.first: What man is he that luſteth to live
verses.second: and would fain ſee good days?

verses.first: Keep thy tongue from evil
verses.second: and thy lips, that they ſpeak no guile.

verses.first: Eſchew evil, and do good
verses.second: ſeek peace, and enſue it.

verses.first: The eyes of the Lord are over the righteous
verses.second: and his ears are open unto their prayers.

verses.first: The countenance of the Lord is againſt them that do evil
verses.second: to root out the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.first: The righteous cry, and the Lord heareth them
verses.second: and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

verses.first: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a contrite heart
verses.second: and will ſave ſuch as be of an humble ſpirit.

verses.first: Great are the troubles of the righteous
verses.second: but the Lord delivereth him out of all.

verses.first: He keepeth all his bones
verses.second: ſo that not one of them is broken.

verses.first: But miſfortune ſhall ſlay the ungodly
verses.second: and they that hate the righteous ſhall be deſolate.

verses.first: The Lord delivereth the ſouls of his ſervants
verses.second: and all they that put their truſt in him ſhall not be deſtitute.

verses.first: PLEAD thou my cauſe, O Lord, with them that ſtrive with me
verses.second: and fight thou againſt them that fight againſt me.

verses.first: Lay hand upon the ſhield and buckler
verses.second: and ſtand up to help me.

verses.first: Bring forth the ſpear, and ſtop the way againſt them that perſecute me
verses.second: ſay unto my ſoul, I am thy ſalvation.

verses.first: Let them be confounded and put to ſhame, that ſeek after my ſoul
verses.second: let them be turned back and brought to confuſion, that imagine miſchief for me.

verses.first: Let them be as the duſt before the wind
verses.second: and the angel of the Lord ſcattering them.

verses.first: Let their way be dark and ſlippery
verses.second: and let the angel of the Lord perſecute them.

verses.first: For they have privily laid their net to deſtroy me without a cauſe
verses.second: yea, even without a cauſe have they made a pit for my ſoul.

verses.first: Let a ſudden deſtruction come upon him unawares, and his net, that he hath laid privily, catch himſelf
verses.second: that he may fall into his own miſchief.

verses.first: And, my ſoul, be joyful in the Lord
verses.second: it ſhall rejoice in his ſalvation.

verses.first: All my bones ſhall ſay, Lord, who is like unto thee, who delivereſt the poor from him that is too ſtrong for him
verses.second: yea, the poor, and him that is in miſery, from him that ſpoileth him?

verses.first: Falſe witneſſes did riſe up
verses.second: they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

verses.first: They rewarded me evil for good
verses.second: to the great diſcomfort of my ſoul.

verses.first: Nevertheleſs, when they were ſick, I put on ſackcloth, and humbled my ſoul with faſting.
verses.second: and my prayer ſhall turn into mine own boſom.

verses.first: I behaved myſelf as though it had been my friend or my brother
verses.second: I went heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

verses.first: But in mine adverſity they rejoiced, and gathered themſelves together
verses.second: yea, the very abjects came together againſt me unawares, making mouths at me, and ceaſed not.

verses.first: With the flatterers were buſy mockers
verses.second: who gnaſhed upon me with their teeth.

verses.first: Lord, how long wilt though look upon this
verses.second: O deliver my ſoul from the calamities which they bring on me, and my darling from the lions.

verses.first: So will I give thee thanks in the great congregation
verses.second: I will praiſe thee among much people.

verses.first: O let not them that are mine enemies triumph over me ungodly
verses.second: neither let them wink with their eyes that they hate me without a cauſe.

verses.text: And why? their communing is not for peace; but they imagine deceitful words againſt them that are quiet in the land.

verses.first: They gaped upon me with their mouths, and ſaid
verses.second: Fie on thee, fie on thee, we ſaw it with our eyes.

verses.first: This thou haſt ſeen, O Lord
verses.second: hold not thy tongue then, go not far from me, O Lord.

verses.first: Awake, and ſtand up to judge my quarrel
verses.second: avenge thou my cauſe, my God, and my Lord.

verses.first: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to thy righteouſneſs
verses.second: and let them not triumph over me.

verses.first: Let them not ſay in their hearts, There, there, ſo would we have it
verses.second: neither let them ſay, We have devoured him.

verses.first: Let them be put to confuſion and ſhame together, that rejoice at my trouble
verses.second: let them be clothed with rebuke and diſhonour, that boaſt themſelves againſt me.

verses.first: Let them be glad and rejoice, that favour my righteous dealing
verses.second: yea, let them ſay alway, Bleſſed be the Lord, who hath pleaſure in the proſperity of his ſervant.

verses.first: And as for my tongue, it ſhall be talking of thy righteouſneſs
verses.second: and of thy praiſe all the day long.

verses.first: MY heart ſheweth me the wickedneſs of the ungodly
verses.second: that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.first: For he flattereth himſelf in his own ſight
verses.second: until his abominable ſin be found out.

verses.first: The words of his mouth are unrighteous, and full of deceit
verses.second: he hath left off to behave himſelf wiſely, and to do good.

verses.first: He imagineth miſchief upon his bed, and hath ſet himſelf in no good way
verses.second: neither doth he abhor any thing that is evil.

verses.first: Thy mercy, O Lord, reacheth unto the heavens
verses.second: and thy faithfulneſs unto the clouds.

verses.first: Thy righteouſneſs ſtandeth like the ſtrong mountains
verses.second: thy judgments are like the great deep.

verses.first: Thou, Lord, ſhalt ſave both man and beaſt; How excellent is thy mercy, O God
verses.second: and the children of men ſhall put their truſt under the ſhadow of thy wings.

verses.first: They ſhall be ſatiſfied with the plenteM ouſneſs of thy houſe
verses.second: and thou ſhalt give them drink of thy pleaſures, as out of the river.

verses.first: For with thee is the well of life
verses.second: and in thy light ſhall we ſee light.

verses.first: O continue forth thy loving-kindneſs unto them that know thee
verses.second: and thy righteouſneſs unto them that are true of heart.

verses.first: O let not the foot of pride come againſt me
verses.second: and let not the hand of the ungodly caſt me down.

verses.first: There are they fallen, all that work wickedneſs
verses.second: they are caſt down, and ſhall not be able to ſtand.

verses.first: FRET not thyſelf becauſe of the ungodly
verses.second: neither be thou envious againſt the evil doers.

verses.first: For they ſhall ſoon be cut down like the graſs
verses.second: and be withered even as the green herb.

verses.first: Put thou thy truſt in the Lord, and be doing good
verses.second: dwell in the land, and verily thou ſhalt be fed.

verses.first: Delight thou in the Lord
verses.second: and he ſhall give thee thy heart’s deſire.

verses.first: Commit thy way unto the Lord, and put thy truſt in him
verses.second: and he ſhall bring it to paſs.

verses.text: He ſhall make thy righteouſneſs as clear as the light ; and thy juſt dealing as the noonday.

verses.first: Hold thee ſtill in the Lord, and abide patiently upon him
verses.second: but grieve not thyſelf at him whoſe way doth proſper, againſt the man that doeth after evil counſels.

verses.first: Leave off from wrath, and let go diſpleaſure
verses.second: fret not thyſelf, elſe ſhalt thou be moved to do evil.

verses.first: Wicked doers ſhall be rooted out
verses.second: and they that patiently abide the Lord, thoſe ſhall inherit the land.

verses.first: Yet a little while, and the ungodly ſhall be clean gone
verses.second: thou ſhalt look after his place, and he ſhall be away.

verses.first: But the meekſpirited ſhall poſſeſs the earth
verses.second: and ſhall be refreſhed in the multitude of peace.

verses.first: The ungodly ſeeketh counſel againſt the juſt
verses.second: and gnaſheth upon him with his teeth.

verses.first: The Lord ſhall laugh him to ſcorn
verses.second: for he hath ſeen that his day is coming.

verses.first: The ungodly have drawn out the ſword, and have bent their bow
verses.second: to caſt down the poor and needy, and to ſlay ſuch as are of a right converſation.

verses.first: Their ſword ſhall go through their own heart
verses.second: and their bow ſhall be broken.

verses.first: A ſmall thing that the righteous hath
verses.second: is better than great riches of the ungodly.

verses.first: For the arms of the ungodly ſhall be broken
verses.second: and the Lord upholdeth the righteous.

verses.first: The Lord knoweth the days of the godly
verses.second: and their inheritance ſhall endure for ever.

verses.first: They ſhall not be confounded in the perilous time
verses.second: and in the days of dearth they ſhall have enough.

verses.first: As for the ungodly, they ſhall periſh; and the enemies of the Lord ſhall conſume as the fat of lambs
verses.second: yea, even as the ſmoke ſhall they conſume away.

verses.first: The ungodly borroweth, and payeth not again
verses.second: but the righteous is merciful and liberal.

verses.first: Such as are bleſſed of God ſhall poſſeſs the land
verses.second: and they that are curſed of him, ſhall be rooted out.

verses.first: The Lord ordereth a good man’s going
verses.second: and maketh his way acceptable to himſelf.

verses.first: Though he fall, he ſhall not be caſt away
verses.second: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.

verses.first: I have been young, and now am old
verses.second: and yet ſaw I never the righteous forſaken, nor his ſeed begging their bread.

verses.first: The righteous is ever merciful, and lendeth
verses.second: and his ſeed is bleſſed.

verses.first: Flee from evil, and do the thing that is good
verses.second: and dwell for evermore.

verses.first: For the Lord loveth the thing that is right
verses.second: he forſaketh not his that be godly, but they are preſerved for ever.

verses.first: The unrighteous ſhall be puniſhed
verses.second: as for the ſeed of the ungodly, it ſhall be rooted out.

verses.first: The righteous ſhall inherit the land
verses.second: and dwell therein forever.

verses.first: The mouth of the righteous is exerciſed in wiſdom
verses.second: and his tongue will be talking of judgment.

verses.first: The law of his God is in his heart
verses.second: and his goings ſhall not ſlide.

verses.first: The ungodly ſeeth the righteous
verses.second: and ſeeketh occaſion to ſlay him.

verses.first: The Lord will not leave him in his hand
verses.second: nor condemn him when he is judged.

verses.first: Hope thou in the Lord, and keep his way, and he ſhall promote thee, that thou ſhalt poſſeſs the land
verses.second: when the ungodly ſhall periſh, thou ſhalt ſee it.

verses.first: I myſelf have ſeen the ungodly in great power
verses.second: and flouriſhing like a green bay-tree.

verses.first: I went by, and lo, he was gone
verses.second: I ſought him, but his place could no where be found.

verses.first: Keep innocency, and take heed unto the thing that is right
verses.second: for that ſhall bring a man peace at the laſt.

verses.first: As for the tranſgreſſors, they ſhall periſh together
verses.second: and the end of the ungodly is, they ſhall be rooted out at the laſt.

verses.first: But the ſalvation of the righteous com- eth of the Lord
verses.second: who is alſo their ſtrength in the time of trouble.

verses.first: And the Lord ſhall ſtand by them, and ſave them
verses.second: he ſhall deliver them from the ungodly, and ſhall ſave them, becauſe they put their truſt in him.

verses.first: PUT me not to rebuke, O Lord, in thine anger
verses.second: neither chaſten me in thy heavy diſpleaſure.

verses.first: For thine arrows ſtick faſt in me
verses.second: and thy hand preſſeth me ſore.

verses.first: There is no health in my fleſh, becauſe of thy diſpleaſure
verses.second: neither is there any reſt in my bones, by reaſon of my ſin.

verses.first: For my wickedneſſes are gone over my head
verses.second: and are like a ſore burden, too heavy for me to bear.

verses.first: My wounds ſtink, and are corrupt
verses.second: through my fooliſhneſs.

verses.first: I am brought into ſo great trouble and miſery
verses.second: that I go mourning all the day long.

verses.first: For my loins are filled with a ſore diſeaſe
verses.second: and there is no whole part in my body.

verses.first: I am feeble, and ſore ſmitten
verses.second: I have roared for the very diſquietneſs of my heart.

verses.first: Lord, thou knoweſt all my deſire
verses.second: and my groaning is not hid from thee.

verses.first: My heart panteth, my ſtrength hath failed me
verses.second: and the ſight of mine eyes is gone from me.

verses.first: My lovers and my neighbours did ſtand looking upon my trouble
verses.second: and my kinſmen ſtood afar off.

verses.first: They alſo that ſought after my life laid ſnares for me
verses.second: and they that went about to do me evil talked of wickedneſs, and imagined deceit all the day long.

verses.first: As for me I was like a deaf men, and heard not
verses.second: and as one that is dumb, who doth not open his mouth.

verses.first: I became even as a man that heareth not
verses.second: and in whoſe mouth are no reproofs.

verses.first: For in thee, O Lord, have I put my truſt
verses.second: thou ſhalt anſwer for me, O Lord my God.

verses.first: I have required that they, even mine enemies ſhould not triumph over me
verses.second: for when my foot ſlipped, they rejoiced greatly againſt me.

verses.first: And I, truly, am ſet in the plague
verses.second: and my heavineſs is ever in my ſight.

verses.first: For I will confeſs my wickedneſs
verses.second: and be ſorry for my ſin.

verses.first: But mine enemies live, and are mighty
verses.second: and they that hate me wrongfully are many in number.

verses.first: They alſo that reward evil for good are againſt me
verses.second: becauſe I follow the thing that good is.

verses.first: Forſake me not, O Lord my God
verses.second: be not thou far from me.

verses.first: Haſte thee to help me
verses.second: O Lord God of my ſalvation.

verses.first: I Said, I will take heed to my ways
verses.second: that I offend not in my tongue.

verses.first: I will keep my mouth as it were with a bridle
verses.second: while the ungodly is in my ſight.

verses.first: I held my tongue, and ſpake nothing
verses.second: I kept ſilence, yea, even from good words; but it was pain and grief to me.

verses.first: My heart was hot within me, and while I was thus muſing, the fire kindled
verses.second: and at the laſt I ſpake with my tongue.

verses.first: Lord, let me know mine end, and the number of my days
verses.second: that I may be certified how long I have to live.

verses.first: Behold, thou haſt made my days as it were a ſpan long
verses.second: and mine age is even as nothing in reſpect of thee; and verily every man living is altogether vanity.

verses.first: For man walketh in a vain ſhadow, and diſquieteth himſelf in vain
verses.second: he heapeth up riches, and cannot tell who ſhall gather them.

verses.first: And now, Lord, what is my hope
verses.second: truly my hope is even in thee.

verses.first: Deliver me from all mine offences
verses.second: and make me not a rebuke unto the fooliſh.

verses.first: I became dumb, and opened not my mouth
verses.second: for it was thy doing.

verses.first: Take thy plague away from me
verses.second: I am even conſumed by the means of thy heavy hand.

verses.first: When thou with rebukes doſt chaſten man for ſin, thou makeſt his beauty to conſume away, like as it were a moth fretting a garment
verses.second: every man therefore is but vanity.

verses.first: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and with thine ears conſider my calling
verses.second: hold not thy peace at my tears.

verses.first: For I am a ſtranger with thee
verses.second: and a ſojourner, as all my fathers were.

verses.first: O ſpare me a little, that I may recover my ſtrength
verses.second: before I go hence, and be no more ſeen.

verses.first: I Waited patiently for the Lord
verses.second: and he inclined unto me, and heard my calling.

verses.first: He brought me alſo out of the horrible pit, out of the mire and clay
verses.second: and ſet my feet upon the rock, and ordered my goings.

verses.first: And he hath put a new ſong in my mouth
verses.second: even a thankſgiving unto our God.

verses.first: Many ſhall ſee it, and fear
verses.second: and ſhall put their truſt in the Lord.

verses.first: Bleſſed is the man that hath ſet his hope in the Lord
verses.second: and turned not unto the proud, and to ſuch as go about with lies.

verses.text: O Lord my God, great are the wondrous works which thou haſt done, like as be alſo thy thoughts which are to us-ward: and yet there is no man that ordereth them unto thee:

verses.first: If I ſhould declare them, and ſpeak of them
verses.second: they ſhould be more than I am able to expreſs.

verses.first: Sacrifice and meat-offering thou wouldeſt not
verses.second: but mine ears haſt thou opened.

verses.first: Burnt-offerings, and ſacrifice for ſin, haſt thou not required
verses.second: then ſaid I, Lo, I come,

verses.first: In the volume of the book it is written of me, that I ſhould fulfil thy will, O my God
verses.second: I am content to do it; yea, thy law is within my heart.

verses.first: I have declared thy righteouſneſs in the great congregation
verses.second: lo, I will not refrain my lips, O Lord, and that thou knoweſt.

verses.first: I have not hid thy righteouſneſs within my heart
verses.second: my talk hath been of thy truth, and of thy ſalvation.

verses.first: I have not kept back thy loving mercy and truth
verses.second: from the great congregation.

verses.first: Withdraw not thou thy mercy from me, O Lord
verses.second: let thy loving-kindneſs and thy truth alway preſerve me.
