verses.second: ſo that they might not drink of the rivers.

verses.first: He ſent lice among them, and devoured them up
verses.second: and frogs to deſtroy them.

verses.first: He gave their fruit unto the caterpillar
verses.second: and their labour unto the graſſhopper.

verses.first: He deſtroyed their vines with hailſtones
verses.second: and their mulberry-trees with the froſt.

verses.first: He ſmote their cattle alſo with hailſtones
verses.second: and their flocks with hot thunderbolts.

verses.first: He caſt upon them the furiouſneſs of his wrath, anger, diſpleaſure and trouble
verses.second: and ſent evil angels among them.

verses.first: He made a way to his indignation, and ſpared not their ſoul from death
verses.second: but gave their life over to the peſtilence;

verses.first: And ſmote all the firſt-born in Egypt
verses.second: the moſt principal and mightieſt in the dwellings of Ham.

verses.first: But as for his own people, he led them forth like ſheep
verses.second: and carried them in the wilderneſs like a flock.

verses.first: He brought them out ſafely, that they ſhould not fear
verses.second: and overwhelmed their enemies with the ſea.

verses.first: And brought them within the borders of his ſanctuary
verses.second: even to his mountain which he purchaſed with his right hand.

verses.first: He caſt out the heathen alſo before them
verses.second: cauſed their land to be divided among them for an heritage, and made the tribes of Iſrael to dwell in their tents.

verses.first: So they tempted and diſpleaſed the moſt high God
verses.second: and kept not his teſtimonies;

verses.first: But turned their backs, and fell away like their forefathers
verses.second: ſtarting aſide like a broken bow.

verses.first: For they grieved him with their hill-altars
verses.second: and provoked him to diſpleaſure with their images.

verses.first: When God heard this, he was wroth
verses.second: and took ſore diſpleaſure at Iſrael.

verses.first: So that he forſook the tabernacle in Silo
verses.second: even the tent that he had pitched among men.

verses.first: He delivered their power into captivity
verses.second: and their beauty into the enemy's hand.

verses.first: He gave his people over alſo unto the ſword
verses.second: and was wroth with his inheritance.

verses.first: The fire conſumed their young men
verses.second: and their maidens were not given to marriage.

verses.first: Their prieſts were ſlain with the ſword
verses.second: and there were no widows to make lamentation.

verses.first: So the Lord awaked as one out of ſleep
verses.second: and like a giant refreſhed with wine.

verses.first: He ſmote his enemies in the hinder parts
verses.second: and put them to a perpetual ſhame.

verses.first: He refuſed the tabernacle of Joſeph
verses.second: and choſe not the tribe of Ephraim;

verses.first: But choſe the tribe of Judah
verses.second: even the hill of Sion which he loved.

verses.first: And there he built his temple on high
verses.second: and laid the foundation of it like the ground which he hath made continually.

verses.first: He choſe David alſo his ſervant
verses.second: and took him away from the ſheep-folds.

verses.first: As he was following the ewes great with young ones he took him
verses.second: that he might feed Jacob his people, and Iſrael his inheritance.

verses.first: So he fed them with a faithful and true heart
verses.second: and ruled them prudently with all his power.

verses.first: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance
verses.second: thy holy temple have they defiled, and made Jeruſalem an heap of ſtones.

verses.first: The dead bodies of thy ſervants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the air
verses.second: and the fleſh of thy ſaints unto the beaſts of the land.

verses.first: Their blood have they ſhed like water on every ſide of Jeruſalem
verses.second: and there was no man to bury them.

verses.first: We are become an open ſhame to our enemies
verses.second: a very ſcorn and deriſion unto them that are round about us.

verses.first: Lord, how long wilt thou be angry
verses.second: ſhall thy jealouſy burn like fire for ever?

verses.first: Pour out thine indignation upon the heathen that have not known thee
verses.second: and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy Name.

verses.first: For they have devoured Jacob
verses.second: and laid waſte his dwelling place.

verses.first: O remember not our old ſins, but have mercy upon us, and that ſoon
verses.second: for we are come to great miſery.

verses.first: Help us, O God of our ſalvation, for the glory of thy Name
verses.second: O deliver us, and be merciful unto our ſins, for thy Name’s ſake.

verses.first: Wherefore do the heathen ſay
verses.second: Where is now their God?

verses.first: O let the vengeance of thy ſervants blood that is ſhed
verses.second: be openly ſhewed upon the heathen in our ſight.

verses.first: O let the ſorrowful ſighing of the priſoners come before thee
verses.second: according to the greatneſs of thy power, preſerve thou thoſe that are appointed to die.

verses.first: And for the blaſphemy wherewith our neighbours have blaſphemed thee
verses.second: reward thou them, O Lord, ſeven-fold into their boſom.

verses.first: So we, that are thy people, and ſheep of thy paſture, ſhall give thee thanks for ever
verses.second: and will alway be ſhewing forth thy praiſe from generation to generation.

verses.first: HEAR, O thou Shepherd of Iſrael, thou that leadeſt Joſeph like a ſheep
verses.second: ſhew thyſelf alſo, thou that ſitteſt upon the cherubims.

verses.first: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manaſſes
verses.second: ſtir up thy ſtrength, and come, and help us.

verses.first: Turn us again, O God
verses.second: ſhew the light of thy countenance, and we ſhall be whole.

verses.first: O Lord God of hoſts
verses.second: how long wilt thou be angry with thy people that prayeth?

verses.first: Thou feedeſt them with the bread of tears
verses.second: and giveſt them plenteouſneſs of tears to drink.

verses.first: Thou haſt made us a very ſtrife unto our neighbours
verses.second: and our enemies laugh us to ſcorn.

verses.first: Turn us again, thou God of hoſts
verses.second: ſhew the light of thy countenance, and we ſhall be whole.

verses.first: Thou haſt brought a vine out of Egypt
verses.second: thou haſt caſt out the heathen, and planted it.

verses.first: Thou madeſt room for it
verses.second: and when it had taken root, it filled the land.

verses.first: The hills were covered with the ſhadow of it
verses.second: and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedar-trees.

verses.first: She ſtretched out her branches unto the ſea
verses.second: and her boughs unto the river.

verses.first: Why haſt thou then broken down her hedge
verses.second: that all they that go by pluck off her grapes?

verses.first: The wild boar out of the wood doth root it up
verses.second: and the wild beaſts of the field devour it.

verses.first: Turn thee again, thou God of hoſts, look down from heaven
verses.second: behold, and viſit this vine;

verses.first: And the place of the vineyard that thy right hand hath planted
verses.second: and the branch that thou madeſt ſo ſtrong for thyſelf.

verses.first: It is burnt with fire, and cut down
verses.second: and they ſhall periſh at the rebuke of thy countenance.

verses.first: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand
verses.second: and upon the ſon of man, whom thou madeſt ſo ſtrong for thine own ſelf.

verses.first: And ſo will not we go back from thee
verses.second: O let us live, and we ſhall call upon thy Name.

verses.first: Turn us again, O Lord God of hoſts
verses.second: ſhew the light of thy countenance, and we ſhall be whole.

verses.first: SING we merrily unto God our ſtrength
verses.second: make a cheerful noiſe unto the God of Jacob.

verses.first: Take the pſalm, bring hither the tabret
verses.second: the merry harp with the lute.

verses.first: Blow up the trumpet in the new-moon
verses.second: even in the time appointed, and upon our ſolemn feaſt-day.

verses.first: For this was made a ſtatute for Iſrael
verses.second: and a law of the God of Jacob.

verses.first: This he ordained in Joſeph for a teſtimony
verses.second: when he came out of the land of Egypt, and had heard a ſtrange language.

verses.first: I eaſed his ſhoulder from the burden
verses.second: and his hands were delivered from making the pots.

verses.first: Thou calledſt upon me in troubles, and I delivered thee
verses.second: and heard thee what time as the ſtorm fell upon thee.

verses.first: I proved thee alſo
verses.second: at the waters of ſtrife.

verses.first: Hear, O my people, and I will aſſure thee, O Iſrael
verses.second: if thou wilt hearken unto me,

verses.first: There ſhall no ſtrange god be in thee
verses.second: neither ſhalt thou worſhip any other god.

verses.first: I am the Lord thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt
verses.second: open thy mouth wide, and I ſhall fill it.

verses.first: But my people would not hear my voice
verses.second: and Iſrael would not obey me.

verses.first: So I gave them up unto their own hearts luſts
verses.second: and let them follow their own imaginations.

verses.first: O that my people would have hearkened unto me
verses.second: for if Iſrael had walked in my ways,

verses.first: I ſhould ſoon have put down their enemies
verses.second: and turned my hand againſt their adverſaries.

verses.first: The haters of the Lord ſhould have been found liars
verses.second: but their time ſhould have endured for ever.

verses.first: He ſhould have fed them alſo with the fineſt wheat-flour
verses.second: and with honey out of the ſtony rock ſhould I have ſatiſfied thee.

verses.first: GOD ſtandeth in the congregation of princes
verses.second: he is a Judge among gods.

verses.first: How long will ye give wrong judgment
verses.second: and accept the perſons of the ungodly?

verses.first: Defend the poor and fatherleſs
verses.second: ſee that ſuch as are in need and neceſſity have right.

verses.first: Deliver the outcaſt and poor
verses.second: ſave them from the hand of the ungodly.

verses.first: They will not be learned nor underſtand, but walk on ſtill in darkneſs
verses.second: all the foundations of the earth are out of courſe.

verses.first: I have ſaid, Ye are gods
verses.second: and ye are all the children of the moſt Higheſt.

verses.first: But ye ſhall die like men
verses.second: and fall like one of the princes.

verses.first: Ariſe, O God, and judge thou the earth
verses.second: for thou ſhalt take all heathen to thine inheritance.

verses.first: HOLD not thy tongue, O God, keep not ſtill ſilence
verses.second: refrain not thyſelf, O God.

verses.first: For lo, thine enemies make a murmuring
verses.second: and they that hate thee have lift up their head.

verses.first: They have imagined craftily againſt thy people
verses.second: and taken counſel againſt thy ſecret ones.

verses.first: They have ſaid, Come, and let us root them out, that they be no more a people
verses.second: and that the name of Iſrael may be no more in remembrance.

verses.first: For they have caſt their heads together with one conſent
verses.second: and are confederate againſt thee;

verses.first: The tabernacles of the Edomites, and the Iſmaelites
verses.second: the Moabites and Hagarenes;

verses.first: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek
verses.second: the Philiſtines, with them that dwell at Tyre.

verses.first: Aſſur alſo is joined with them
verses.second: and have holpen the children of Lot.

verses.first: But do thou to them as unto the Madianites
verses.second: unto Si ſera, and unto Jabin at the brook of Kiſon;

verses.first: Who periſhed at Endor
verses.second: and became as the dung of the earth.

verses.first: Make them and their princes like Oreb and Zeb
verses.second: yea, make all their princes like as Zeba and Salmana;

verses.first: Who ſay, Let us take to ourſelves
verses.second: the houſes of God in poſſeſſion.

verses.first: O my God, make them like unto a wheel
verses.second: and as the ſtubble before the wind;

verses.first: Like as the fire that burneth up the wood
verses.second: and as the flame that conſumeth the mountains.

verses.first: Perſecute them even ſo with thy tempeſt
verses.second: and make them afraid with thy ſtorm.

verses.first: Make their faces aſhamed, O Lord
verses.second: that they may ſeek thy Name.

verses.first: Let them be confounded and vexed ever more and more
verses.second: let them be put to ſhame, and periſh.

verses.first: And they ſhall know that thou, whoſe Name is Jehovah
verses.second: art only the moſt Higheſt over all the earth.

verses.first: O How amiable are thy dwellings
verses.second: thou Lord of hoſts!

verses.first: My ſoul hath a deſire and longing to enter into the courts of the Lord
verses.second: my heart and my fleſh rejoice in the living God.

verses.first: Yea, the ſparrow hath found her an houſe, and the ſwallow a neſt where ſhe may lay her young
verses.second: even thy altars, O Lord of hoſts, my King and my God.

verses.first: Bleſſed are they that dwell in thy houſe
verses.second: they will be alway praiſing thee.

verses.first: Bleſſed is the man whoſe ſtrength is in thee
verses.second: in whoſe heart are thy ways.

verses.first: Who going through the vale of miſery uſe it for a well
verses.second: and the pools are filled with water.

verses.first: They will go from ſtrength to ſtrength
verses.second: and unto the God of gods appeareth every one of them in Sion.

verses.first: O Lord God of hoſts, hear my prayer
verses.second: hearken, O God of Jacob.

verses.first: Behold, O God our defender
verses.second: and look upon the face of thine Anointed.

verses.first: For one day in thy courts
verses.second: is better than a thouſand.

verses.first: I had rather be a door-keeper in the houſe of my God
verses.second: than to dwell in the tents of ungodlineſs.

verses.first: For the Lord God is a light and defence
verses.second: the Lord will give grace and worſhip, and no good thing ſhall he withhold from them that live a godly life.

verses.first: O Lord God of hoſts
verses.second: bleſſed is the man that putteth his truſt in thee.

verses.first: LORD, thou art become gracious unto thy land
verses.second: thou haſt turned away the captivity of Jacob.

verses.first: Thou haſt forgiven the offence of thy people
verses.second: and covered all their ſins.

verses.first: Thou haſt taken away all thy diſpleaſure
verses.second: and turned thyſelf from thy wrathful indignation.

verses.first: Turn us then, O God our Saviour
verses.second: and let thine anger ceaſe from us.

verses.first: Wilt thou be diſpleaſed at us for ever
verses.second: and wilt thou ſtretch out thy wrath from one generation to another?

verses.first: Wilt thou not turn again, and quicken us
verses.second: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

verses.first: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord
verses.second: and grant us thy ſalvation.

verses.first: I will hearken what the Lord God will ſay concerning me
verses.second: for he ſhall ſpeak peace unto his people, and to his ſaints, that they turn not again.

verses.first: For his ſalvation is nigh them that fear him
verses.second: that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.first: Mercy and truth are met together
verses.second: righteouſneſs and peace have kiſſed each other.

verses.first: Truth ſhall flouriſh out of the earth
verses.second: and righteouſneſs hath looked down from heaven.

verses.first: Yea, the Lord ſhall ſhew loving-kindneſs
verses.second: and our land ſhall give her increaſe.

verses.first: Righteouſneſs ſhall go before him
verses.second: and he ſhall direct his going in the way.

verses.first: BOW down thine ear, O Lord, and hear me
verses.second: for I am poor, and in miſery.

verses.first: Preſerve thou my ſoul, for I am holy
verses.second: my God, ſave thy ſervant that putteth his truſt in thee.

verses.first: Be merciful unto me, O Lord
verses.second: for I will call daily upon thee.

verses.first: Comfort the ſoul of thy ſervant
verses.second: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my ſoul.

verses.first: For thou, Lord, art good and gracious
verses.second: and of great mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

verses.first: Give ear, Lord, unto my prayer
verses.second: and ponder the voice of my humble deſires.

verses.first: In the time of my trouble I will call upon thee
verses.second: for thou heareſt me.

verses.first: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord
verses.second: there is not one that can do as thou doeſt.

verses.first: All nations whom thou hadſt made ſhall come and worſhip thee, O Lord
verses.second: and ſhall glorify thy Name.

verses.first: For thou art great, and doeſt wondrous things
verses.second: thou art God alone.

verses.first: Teach me thy way, O Lord, and I will walk in thy truth
verses.second: O knit my heart unto thee, that I may fear thy Name.

verses.first: I will thank thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart
verses.second: and will praiſe thy Name for evermore.

verses.first: For great is thy mercy toward me
verses.second: and thou haſt delivered my ſoul from the nethermoſt hell.

verses.first: O God, the proud are riſen againſt me
verses.second: and the congregations of naughty men have ſought after my ſoul, and have not ſet thee before their eyes.

verses.first: But thou, O Lord God, art full of compaſſion and mercy
verses.second: longſuffering, plenteous in goodneſs and truth.

verses.first: O turn thee then unto me, and have mercy upon me
verses.second: give thy ſtrength unto thy ſervant, and help the ſon of thine handmaid.

verses.first: Shew ſome token upon me for good, that they who hate me may ſee it and be aſhamed
verses.second: becauſe thou, Lord, haſt holpen me and comforted me.

verses.first: HER foundations are upon the holy hills
verses.second: the Lord loveth the gates of Sion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.first: Very excellent things are ſpoken of thee
verses.second: thou city of God.

verses.first: I will think upon Rahab and Babylon
verses.second: with them that know me. H

verses.first: Behold ye the Philiſtines alſo
verses.second: and they of Tyre, with the Morians; lo, there was he born.

verses.first: And of Sion it ſhall be reported that he was born in her
verses.second: and the moſt High ſhall ſtabliſh her.

verses.first: The Lord ſhall rehearſe it when he writeth up the people
verses.second: that he was born there.

verses.first: The ſingers alſo and trumpeters ſhall he rehearſe
verses.second: All my freſh ſprings ſhall be in thee.

verses.first: O Lord God of my ſalvation, I have cried day and night before thee
verses.second: O let my prayer enter into thy preſence, incline thine ear unto my calling.

verses.first: For my ſoul is full of trouble
verses.second: and my life draweth nigh unto hell.

verses.first: I am counted as one of them that go down into the pit
verses.second: and I have been even as a man that hath no ſtrength.

verses.first: Free among the dead, like unto them that are wounded, and lie in the grave
verses.second: who are out of remembrance, and are cut away from thy hand.

verses.first: Thou haſt laid me in the loweſt pit
verses.second: in a place of darkneſs, and in the deep.

verses.first: Thine indignation lieth hard upon me
verses.second: and thou haſt vexed me with all thy ſtorms.

verses.first: Thou haſt put away mine acquaintance far from me
verses.second: and made me to be abhorred of them.

verses.first: I am ſo faſt in priſon
verses.second: that I cannot get forth.

verses.first: My ſight faileth for very trouble
verses.second: Lord, I have called daily upon thee, I have ſtretched forth my hands unto thee.

verses.first: Doſt thou ſhew wonders among the dead
verses.second: or ſhall the dead riſe up again, and praiſe thee?

verses.first: Shall thy loving-kindneſs be ſhewed in the grave
verses.second: or thy faithfulneſs in deſtruction?

verses.first: Shall thy wondrous works be known in the dark
verses.second: and thy righteouſneſs in the land where all things are forgotten?

verses.first: Unto thee have I cried, O Lord
verses.second: and early ſhall my prayer come before thee.

verses.first: Lord, why abhorreſt thou my ſoul
verses.second: and hideſt thou thy face from me?

verses.first: I am in miſery, and like unto him that is at the point to die
verses.second: even from my youth up thy terrors have I ſuffered with a troubled mind.

verses.first: Thy wrathful diſpleaſure goeth over me
verses.second: and the fear of thee hath undone me.

verses.first: They came round about me daily like water
verses.second: and compaſſed me together on every ſide.

verses.first: My lovers and friends haſt thou put away from me
verses.second: and hid mine acquaintance out of my ſight.

verses.first: MY ſong ſhall be alway of the lovingkindneſs of the Lord
verses.second: with my mouth will I ever be ſhewing thy truth from one generation to another.

verses.first: For I have ſaid, Mercy ſhall be ſet up for ever
verses.second: thy truth ſhalt thou ſtabliſh in the heavens.

verses.first: I have made a covenant with my choſen
verses.second: I have ſworn unto David my ſervant;

verses.first: Thy ſeed will I ſtabliſh for ever
verses.second: and ſet up thy throne from one generation to another.

verses.first: O Lord, the very heavens ſhall praiſe thy wondrous works
verses.second: and thy truth in the congregation of the ſaints.

verses.first: For who is he among the clouds
verses.second: that ſhall be compared unto the Lord?

verses.first: And what is he among the gods
verses.second: that ſhall be like unto the Lord?

verses.first: God is very greatly to be feared in the council of the ſaints
verses.second: and to be had in reverence of all them that are round about him.

verses.first: O Lord God of hoſts, who is like unto thee
verses.second: thy truth, moſt mighty Lord, is on every ſide.

verses.first: Thou ruleſt the raging of the ſea
verses.second: thou ſtilleſt the waves thereof when they ariſe.

verses.first: Thou haſt ſubdued Egypt, and deſtroyed it
verses.second: thou haſt ſcattered thine enemies abroad with thy mighty arm.

verses.first: The heavens are thine, the earth alſo is thine
verses.second: thou haſt laid the foundation of the round world, and all that therein is.

verses.first: Thou haſt made the north and the ſouth
verses.second: Tabor and Hermon ſhall rejoice in thy Name.

verses.first: Thou haſt a mighty arm
verses.second: ſtrong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

verses.first: Righteouſneſs and equity are the habitation of thy ſeat
verses.second: mercy and truth ſhall go before thy face.

verses.first: Bleſſed is the people, O Lord, that can rejoice in thee
verses.second: they ſhall walk in the light of thy countenance.

verses.first: Their delight ſhall be daily in thy Name
verses.second: and in thy righteouſneſs ſhall they make their boaſt.

verses.first: For thou art the glory of their ſtrength
verses.second: and in thy loving-kindneſs thou ſhalt lift up our horns.

verses.first: For the Lord is our defence
verses.second: the Holy One of Iſrael is our King.

verses.first: Thou ſpakeſt ſometime in viſions unto thy ſaints, and ſaidſt
verses.second: I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one choſen out of the people.

verses.first: I have found David my ſervant
verses.second: with my holy oil have I anointed him.

verses.first: My hand ſhall hold him faſt
verses.second: and my arm ſhall ſtrengthen him.

verses.first: The enemy ſhall not be able to do him violence
verses.second: the ſon of wickedneſs ſhall not hurt him.

verses.first: I will ſmite down his foes before his face
verses.second: and plague them that hate him.

verses.first: My truth alſo and my mercy ſhall be with him
verses.second: and in my Name ſhall his horn be exalted.

verses.first: I will ſet his dominion alſo in the ſea
verses.second: and his right hand in the floods.

verses.first: He ſhall call me, Thou art my Father
verses.second: my God, and my ſtrong ſalvation.

verses.first: And I will make him my firſt-born
verses.second: higher than the kings of the earth.

verses.first: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore
verses.second: and my covenant ſhall ſtand faſt with him.

verses.first: His ſeed alſo will I make to endure for ever
verses.second: and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.first: But if his children forſake my law
verses.second: and walk not in my judgments;

verses.first: If they break my ſtatutes, and keep not my commandments
verses.second: I will viſit their offences with the rod, and their ſin with ſcourges.

verses.first: Nevertheleſs, my loving-kindneſs will I not utterly take from him
verses.second: nor ſuffer my truth to fail.

verses.first: My covenant I will not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips
verses.second: I have ſworn once by my holineſs, that I will not fail David.

verses.first: His ſeed ſhall endure for ever
verses.second: and his ſeat is like as the ſun before me.

verses.first: He ſhall ſtand faſt for evermore as the moon
verses.second: and as the faithful witneſs in heaven.

verses.first: But thou haſt abhorred and forſaken thine Anointed
verses.second: and art diſpleaſed at him.

verses.first: Thou haſt broken the covenant of thy ſervant
verses.second: and caſt his crown to the ground.

verses.first: Thou haſt overthrown all his hedges
verses.second: and broken down his ſtrong holds.

verses.first: All they that go by ſpoil him
verses.second: and he is become a reproach to his neighbours.

verses.first: Thou haſt ſet up the right hand of his enemies
verses.second: and made all his adverſaries to rejoice.

verses.first: Thou haſt taken away the edge of his ſword
verses.second: and giveſt him not victory in the battle.

verses.first: Thou haſt put out his glory
verses.second: and caſt his throne down to the ground.

verses.first: The days of his youth haſt thou ſhortened
verses.second: and covered him with diſhonour.

verses.first: Lord, how long wilt thou hide thyſelf, for ever
verses.second: and ſhall thy wrath burn like fire?

verses.first: O remember how ſhort my time is
verses.second: wherefore haſt thou made all men for nought?

verses.first: What man is he that liveth, and ſhall not ſee death
verses.second: and ſhall he deliver his ſoul from the hand of hell?

verses.first: Lord, where are thy old loving-kindneſſes
verses.second: which thou ſwareſt unto David in thy truth?

verses.first: Remember, Lord, the rebuke that thy ſervants have
verses.second: and how I do bear in my boſom the rebukes of many people;

verses.first: Wherewith thine enemies have blaſphemed thee, and ſlandered the footſteps of thine Anointed
verses.second: Praiſed be the Lord for ever-more. Amen, and Amen.

verses.first: LORD, thou haſt been our refuge
verses.second: from one generation to another.

verses.first: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever the earth and the world were made
verses.second: thou art God from everlaſting, and world without end.

verses.first: Thou turneſt man to deſtruction
verses.second: again thou ſayeſt, Come again, ye children of men.

verses.first: For a thouſand years in thy ſight are but as yeſterday
verses.second: ſeeing that is paſt as a watch in the night.

verses.first: As ſoon as thou ſcattereſt them, they are even as a ſleep
verses.second: and fade away ſuddenly like the graſs.

verses.first: In the morning it is green, and groweth up
verses.second: but in the evening it is cut down, dried up, and withered.

verses.first: For we conſume away in thy diſpleaſure
verses.second: and are afraid at thy wrathful indignation.

verses.first: Thou haſt ſet our miſdeeds before thee
verses.second: and our ſecret ſins in the light of thy countenance.

verses.first: For when thou art angry all our days are gone
verses.second: we bring our years to an end, as it were a tale that is told.

verses.first: The days of our age are threeſcore years and ten; and though men be ſo ſtrong that they come to fourſcore years
verses.second: yet is their ſtrength then but labour and ſorrow; ſo ſoon paſſeth it away, and we are gone.

verses.first: But who regardeth the power of thy wrath
verses.second: for even thereafter as a man feareth, ſo is thy diſpleaſure.

verses.first: So teach us to number our days
verses.second: that we may apply our hearts unto wiſdom.

verses.first: Turn thee again, O Lord, at the laſt
verses.second: and be gracious unto thy ſervants.

verses.first: O ſatiſfy us with thy mercy, and that ſoon
verses.second: ſo ſhall we rejoice and be glad all the days of our life.

verses.first: Comfort us again now after the time that thou haſt plagued us
verses.second: and for the years wherein we have ſuffered adverſity.

verses.first: Shew thy ſervants thy work
verses.second: and their children thy glory.

verses.first: And the glorious majeſty of the Lord our God be upon us
verses.second: proſper thou the work of our hands upon us, O proſper thou our handywork.

verses.first: WHOSO dwelleth under the defence of the moſt High
verses.second: ſhall abide under the ſhadow of the Almighty.

verses.first: I will ſay unto the Lord, Thou art my hope, and my ſtrong hold
verses.second: my God, in him will I truſt.

verses.first: For he ſhall deliver thee from the ſnare of the hunter
verses.second: and from the noiſome peſtilence.

verses.first: He ſhall defend thee under his wings, and thou ſhalt be ſafe under his feathers
verses.second: his faithfulneſs and truth ſhall be thy ſhield and buckler.

verses.first: Thou ſhalt not be afraid for any terror by night
verses.second: nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

verses.first: For the peſtilence that walketh in darkneſs
verses.second: nor for the ſickneſs that deſtroyeth in the noon-day.

verses.first: A thouſand ſhall fall beſide thee, and ten thouſand at thy right hand
verses.second: but it ſhall not come nigh thee.

verses.first: Yea, with thine eyes ſhalt thou behold
verses.second: and ſee the reward of the ungodly.

verses.first: For thou, Lord, art my hope
verses.second: thou haſt ſet thine houſe of defence very high.

verses.first: There ſhall no evil happen unto thee
verses.second: neither ſhall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

verses.first: For he ſhall give his angels charge over thee
verses.second: to keep thee in all thy ways.

verses.first: They ſhall bear thee in their hands
verses.second: that thou hurt not thy foot againſt a ſtone.

verses.first: Thou ſhalt go upon the lion and adder
verses.second: the young lion and the dragon ſhalt thou tread under thy feet.

verses.first: Becauſe he hath ſet his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him
verses.second: I will ſet him up, becauſe he hath known my Name.

verses.first: He ſhall call upon me, and I will hear him
verses.second: yea, I am with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and bring him to honour.

verses.first: With long life will I ſatiſfy him
verses.second: and ſhew him my ſalvation.

verses.first: IT is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord
verses.second: and to ſing praiſes unto thy Name, O moſt Higheſt;

verses.first: To tell of thy loving-kindneſs early in the morning
verses.second: and of thy truth in the nightſeaſon.

verses.first: Upon an inſtrument of ten ſtrings, and upon the lute
verses.second: upon a loud inſtrument, and upon the harp.

verses.first: For thou, Lord, haſt made me glad through thy works
verses.second: and I will rejoice in giving praiſe for the operations of thy hands.

verses.first: O Lord, how glorious are thy works
verses.second: thy thoughts are very deep!

verses.first: An unwiſe man doth not well conſider this
verses.second: and a fool doth not underſtand it.

verses.first: When the ungodly are green as the graſs, and when all the workers of wickedneſs do flouriſh
verses.second: then ſhall they be deſtroyed for ever; but thou, Lord, art the moſt Higheſt for evermore.

verses.first: For lo, thine enemies, O Lord, lo, thine enemies ſhall periſh
verses.second: and all the workers of wickedneſs ſhall be deſtroyed.

verses.first: But mine horn ſhall be exalted like the horn of an unicorn
verses.second: for I am anointed with freſh oil.

verses.first: Mine eye alſo ſhall ſee his luſt of mine enemies
verses.second: and mine ear ſhall hear his deſire of the wicked that ariſe up againſt me.

verses.first: The righteous ſhall flouriſh like a palmtree
verses.second: and ſhall ſpread abroad like a cedar in Libanus.

verses.first: Such as are planted in the houſe of the Lord
verses.second: ſhall flouriſh in the courts of the houſe of our God.

verses.first: They alſo ſhall bring forth more fruit in their age
verses.second: and ſhall be fat and well-liking.

verses.first: That they may ſhew how true the Lord my ſtrength is
verses.second: and that there is no unrighteouſneſs in him.

verses.first: THE Lord is King, and hath put on glorious apparel
verses.second: the Lord hath put on his apparel, and girded himſelf with ſtrength.

verses.first: He hath made the round world ſo ſure
verses.second: that it cannot be moved.

verses.first: Ever ſince the world began hath thy ſeat been prepared
verses.second: thou art from everlaſting.

verses.first: The floods are riſen, O Lord, the floods have lift up their voice
verses.second: the floods lift up their waves.

verses.first: The waves of the ſea are mighty, and rage horribly
verses.second: but yet the Lord, who dwelleth on high, is mightier.

verses.first: Thy teſtimonies, O Lord, are very ſure
verses.second: holineſs becometh thine houſe for ever.

verses.first: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth
verses.second: thou God, to whom vengeance belongeth, ſhew thyſelf.

verses.first: Ariſe, thou Judge of the world
verses.second: and reward the proud after their deſerving.

verses.first: Lord, how long ſhall the ungodly
verses.second: how long ſhall the ungodly triumph?

verses.first: How long ſhall all wicked doers ſpeak ſo diſdainfully
verses.second: and make ſuch proud boaſting?

verses.first: They ſmite down thy people, O Lord
verses.second: and trouble thine heritage.

verses.first: They murder the widow and the ſtranger
verses.second: and put the fatherleſs to death.

verses.first: And yet they ſay, Tuſh, the Lord ſhall not ſee
verses.second: neither ſhall the God of Jacob regard it.

verses.first: Take heed, ye unwiſe among the people
verses.second: O ye fools, when will ye underſtand?

verses.first: He that planted the ear, ſhall he not hear
verses.second: or he that made the eye, ſhall he not ſee?

verses.first: Or he that nurtureth the heathen
verses.second: it is he that teacheth man knowledge, ſhall not he puniſh?

verses.first: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of man
verses.second: that they are but vain.

verses.first: Bleſſed is the man whom thou chaſteneſt, O Lord
verses.second: and teacheſt him in thy law.

verses.first: That thou mayeſt give him patience in time of adverſity
verses.second: until the pit be digged up for the ungodly.

verses.first: For the Lord will not fail his people
verses.second: neither will he forſake his inheritance;

verses.first: Until righteouſneſs turn again unto judgment
verses.second: all ſuch as are true in heart ſhall follow it.

verses.first: Who will riſe up with me againſt the wicked
verses.second: or who will take my part againſt the evil-doerſ?

verses.first: If the Lord had not helped me
verses.second: it had not failed but my ſoul had been put to ſilence.

verses.first: But when I ſaid, My foot hath ſlipt
verses.second: thy mercy, O Lord, held me up.

verses.first: In the multitude of the ſorrows that I had in my heart
verses.second: thy comforts have refreſhed my ſoul.

verses.first: Wilt thou have any thing to do with the ſtool of wickedneſs
verses.second: which imagineth miſchief as a law?

verses.first: They gather them together againſt the ſoul of the righteous
verses.second: and condemn the innocent blood.

verses.first: But the Lord is my refuge
verses.second: and my God is the ſtrength of my confidence.

verses.first: He ſhall recompenſe them their wickedneſs, and deſtroy them in their own malice
verses.second: yea, the Lord our God ſhall deſtroy them.

verses.first: O Come, let us ſing unto the Lord
verses.second: let us heartily rejoice in the ſtrength of our ſalvation.

verses.first: Let us come before his preſence with thankſgiving
verses.second: and ſhew ourſelves glad in him with pſalms.

verses.first: For the Lord is a great God
verses.second: and a great King above all gods.

verses.first: In his hand are all the corners of the earth
verses.second: and the ſtrength of the hills is his alſo.

verses.first: The ſea is his, and he made it
verses.second: and his hands prepared the dry land.

verses.first: O come, let us worſhip and fall down
verses.second: and kneel before the Lord our Maker.

verses.first: For he is the Lord our God
verses.second: and we are the people of his paſture, and the ſheep of his hand.

verses.first: To-day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts
verses.second: as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderneſs.

verses.first: When your fathers tempted me
verses.second: proved me, and ſaw my works.

verses.first: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and ſaid
verses.second: It is a people that do err in their hearts, for they have not known my ways;

verses.first: Unto whom I ſware in my wrath
verses.second: that they ſhould not enter into my reſt.

verses.first: O Sing unto the Lord a new ſong
verses.second: ſing unto the Lord, all the whole earth.

verses.first: Sing unto the Lord, and praiſe his Name
verses.second: be telling of his ſalvation from day to day.

verses.first: Declare his honour unto the heathen
verses.second: and his wonders unto all people.

verses.first: For the Lord is great, and cannot worthily be praiſed
verses.second: he is more to be feared than all gods.

verses.first: As for all the gods of the heathen, they are but idols
verses.second: but it is the Lord that made the heavens.

verses.first: Glory and worſhip are before him
verses.second: power and honour are in his ſanctuary.

verses.first: Aſcribe unto the Lord, O ye kindreds of the people
verses.second: aſcribe unto the Lord worſhip and power.

verses.first: Aſcribe unto the Lord the honour due unto his Name
verses.second: bring preſents, and come into his courts.

verses.first: O worſhip the Lord in the beauty of holineſs
verses.second: let the whole earth ſtand in awe of him.

verses.first: Tell it out among the heathen that the Lord is King
verses.second: and that it is he who hath made the round world ſo faſt that it cannot be moved; and how that he ſhall judge the people righteouſly.

verses.first: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad
verses.second: let the ſea make a noiſe, and all that therein is.

verses.first: Let the field be joyful, and all that is in it
verses.second: then ſhall all the trees of the wood rejoice before the Lord.

verses.first: For he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth
verses.second: and with righteouſneſs to judge the world, and the people with his truth.

verses.first: THE Lord is King, the earth may be glad thereof
verses.second: yea, the multitude of the iſles may be glad thereof.

verses.first: Clouds and darkneſs are round about him
verses.second: righteouſneſs and judgment are the habitation of his ſeat.

verses.first: There ſhall go a fire before him
verses.second: and burn up his enemies on every ſide.

verses.first: His lightnings gave ſhine unto the world
verses.second: the earth ſaw it, and was afraid.

verses.first: The hills melted like wax at the preſence of the Lord
verses.second: at the preſence of the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.first: The heavens have declared his righteouſneſs
verses.second: and all the people have ſeen his glory.

verses.first: Confounded be all they that worſhip carved images, and that delight in vain gods
verses.second: worſhip him, all ye gods.

verses.first: Sion heard of it, and rejoiced
verses.second: and the daughters of Judah were glad, becauſe of thy judgments, O Lord.

verses.first: For thou, Lord, art higher than all that are in the earth
verses.second: thou art exalted far above all gods.

verses.first: O ye that love the Lord, ſee that ye hate the thing which is evil
verses.second: the Lord preſerveth the ſouls of his ſaints; he ſhall deliver them from the hand of the ungodly.

verses.first: There is ſprung up a light for the righteous
verses.second: and joyful gladneſs for ſuch as are truehearted.

verses.first: Rejoice in the Lord, ye righteous
verses.second: and give thanks for a remembrance of his holineſs.

verses.first: O Sing unto the Lord a new ſong
verses.second: for he hath done marvellous things.

verses.first: With his own right hand, and with his holy arm
verses.second: hath he gotten himſelf the victory.

verses.first: The Lord declared his ſalvation
verses.second: his righteouſneſs hath he openly ſhewed in the ſight of the heathen.

verses.first: He hath remembered his mercy and truth toward the houſe of Iſrael
verses.second: and all the ends of the world have ſeen the ſalvation of our God.

verses.first: Shew yourſelves joyful unto the Lord, all ye lands
verses.second: ſing, rejoice, and give thanks.

verses.first: Praiſe the Lord upon the harp
verses.second: ſing to the harp with a pſalm of thankſgiving.

verses.first: With trumpets alſo and ſhawms
verses.second: O ſhew yourſelves joyful before the Lord the King.

verses.first: Let the ſea make a noiſe, and all that therein is
verses.second: the round world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.first: Let the floods clap their hands, and let the hills be joyful together before the Lord
verses.second: for he is come to judge the earth.

verses.first: With righteouſneſs ſhall he judge the world
verses.second: and the people with equity.

verses.first: THE Lord is King, be the people never ſo unpatient
verses.second: he ſitteth between the cherubims, be the earth never ſo unquiet.

verses.first: The Lord is great in Sion
verses.second: and high above all people.

verses.first: They ſhall give thanks unto thy Name
verses.second: which is great, wonderful, and holy.

verses.first: The King’s power loveth judgment; thou haſt prepared equity
verses.second: thou haſt executed judgment and righteouſneſs in Jacob.

verses.first: O magnify the Lord our God
verses.second: and fall down before his footſtool, for he is holy.

verses.first: Moſes and Aaron among his prieſts, and Samuel among ſuch as call upon his Name
verses.second: theſe called upon the Lord, and he heard them.

verses.first: He ſpake unto them out of the cloudy pillar
verses.second: for they kept his teſtimonies, and the law that he gave them.

verses.first: Thou heardeſt them, O Lord our God
verses.second: thou forgaveſt them, O God, and puniſhedſt their own inventions.

verses.first: O magnify the Lord our God, and worſhip him upon his holy hill
verses.second: for the Lord our God is holy.

verses.first: O Be joyful in the Lord, all ye lands
verses.second: ſerve the Lord with gladneſs, and come before his preſence with a ſong.

verses.first: Be ye ſure that the Lord he is God; it is he that hath made us, and not we ourſelves
verses.second: we are his people, and the ſheep of his paſture.

verses.first: O go your way into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praiſe
verses.second: be thankful unto him, and ſpeak good of his Name.

verses.first: For the Lord is gracious, his mercy is everlaſting
verses.second: and his truth endureth from generation to generation.

verses.first: MY ſong ſhall be of mercy and judgment
verses.second: unto thee, O Lord, will I ſing.

verses.first: O let me have underſtanding
verses.second: in the way of godlineſs.

verses.first: When wilt thou come unto me
verses.second: I will walk in my houſe with a perfect heart.

verses.first: I will take no wicked thing in hand; I hate the ſins of unfaithfulneſs
verses.second: there ſhall no ſuch cleave unto me.

verses.first: A froward heart ſhall depart from me
verses.second: I will not know a wicked perſon.

verses.first: Who ſo privily ſlandereth his neighbour
verses.second: him will I deſtroy.

verses.first: Who ſo hath alſo a proud look and high ſtomach
verses.second: I will not ſuffer him.

verses.first: Mine eyes look upon ſuch as are faithful in the land
verses.second: that they may dwell with me.

verses.first: Who ſo leadeth a godly life
verses.second: he ſhall be my ſervant.

verses.first: There ſhall no deceitful perſon dwell in my houſe
verses.second: he that telleth lies ſhall not tarry in my ſight.

verses.first: I ſhall ſoon deſtroy all the ungodly that are in the land
verses.second: that I may root out all wicked doers from the city of the Lord.

verses.first: HEAR my prayer, O Lord
verses.second: and let my crying come unto thee.

verses.first: Hide not thy face from me in the time of my trouble
verses.second: incline thine ear unto me when I call; O hear me, and that right ſoon.

verses.first: For my days are conſumed away like ſmoke
verses.second: and my bones are burnt up as it were a firebrand.

verses.first: My heart is ſmitten down, and withered liked graſs
verses.second: ſo that I forget to eat my bread.

verses.first: For the voice of my groaning
verses.second: my bones will ſcarce cleave to my fleſh.

verses.first: I am become like a pelican in the wilderneſs
verses.second: and like an owl that is in the deſert.

verses.first: I have watched, and am even as it were a ſparrow
verses.second: that ſitteth alone upon the houſe-top.

verses.first: Mine enemies revile me all the day long
verses.second: and they that are mad upon me are ſworn together againſt me.

verses.first: For I have eaten aſhes as it were bread
verses.second: and mingled my drink with weeping.

verses.first: And that becauſe of thine indignation and wrath
verses.second: for thou haſt taken me up, and caſt me down.

verses.first: My days are gone like a ſhadow
verses.second: and I am withered like graſs.

verses.first: But thou, O Lord, ſhalt endure for ever
verses.second: and thy remembrance throughout all generations.

verses.first: Thou ſhalt ariſe, and have mercy upon Sion
verses.second: for it is time that thou have mercy upon her, yea, the time is come.

verses.first: And why? thy ſervants think upon her ſtones
verses.second: and it pitieth them to ſee her in the duſt.

verses.first: The heathen ſhall fear thy Name, O Lord
verses.second: and all the kings of the earth thy Majeſty;

verses.first: When the Lord ſhall build up Sion
verses.second: and when his glory ſhall appear;

verses.first: When he turneth him unto the prayer of the poor deſtitute
verses.second: and deſpiſeth not their deſire.

verses.first: This ſhall be written for thoſe that come after
verses.second: and the people which ſhall be born, ſhall praiſe the Lord.

verses.first: For he hath looked down from his ſanctuary
verses.second: out of the heaven did the Lord behold the earth;

verses.first: That he might hear the mournings of ſuch as are in captivity
verses.second: and deliver the children appointed unto death;

verses.first: That they may declare the Name of the Lord in Sion
verses.second: and his worſhip at Jeruſalem;

verses.first: When the people are gathered together
verses.second: and the kingdoms alſo, to ſerve the Lord.

verses.first: He brought down my ſtrength in my journey
verses.second: and ſhortened my days.

verses.first: But I ſaid, O my God, take me not away in the midſt of mine age
verses.second: as for thy years, they endure throughout all generations.

verses.first: Thou, Lord, in the beginning haſt laid the foundation of the earth
verses.second: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

verses.first: They ſhall periſh, but thou ſhalt endure
verses.second: they all ſhall wax old as doth a garment;

verses.first: And as a veſture ſhalt thou change them, and they ſhall be changed
verses.second: but thou art the ſame, and thy years ſhall not fail.

verses.first: The children of thy ſervants ſhall continue
verses.second: and their ſeed ſhall ſtand faſt in thy ſight.

verses.first: PRAISE the Lord, O my ſoul
verses.second: and all that is within me praiſe his holy Name.

verses.first: Praiſe the Lord, O my ſoul
verses.second: and forget not all his benefits;

verses.first: Who forgiveth all thy ſin
verses.second: and healeth all thine infirmities;

verses.first: Who ſaveth thy life from deſtruction
verses.second: and crowneth thee with mercy and loving-kindneſs;

verses.first: Who ſatiſfieth thy mouth with good things
verses.second: making thee young and luſty as an eagle.

verses.first: The Lord executeth righteouſneſs and judgment
verses.second: for all them that are oppreſſed with wrong.

verses.first: He ſhewed his ways unto Moſes
verses.second: his works unto the children of Iſrael.

verses.first: The Lord is full of compaſſion and mercy
verses.second: longſuffering, and of great goodneſs.

verses.first: He will not alway be chiding
verses.second: neither keepeth he his anger for ever.

verses.first: He hath not dealt with us after our ſins
verses.second: nor rewarded us according to our wickedneſſes.

verses.first: For look how high the heaven is in compariſon of the earth
verses.second: ſo great is his mercy alſo toward them that fear him.

verses.first: Look how wide alſo the eaſt is from the weſt
verses.second: ſo far hath he ſet our ſins from us.

verses.first: Yea, like as a father pitieth his own children
verses.second: even ſo is the Lord merciful unto them that fear him.

verses.first: For he knoweth whereof we are made
verses.second: he remembereth that we are but duſt.

verses.first: The days of man are but as graſs
verses.second: for he flouriſheth as a flower of the field.

verses.first: For as ſoon as the wind goeth over it, it is gone
verses.second: and the place thereof ſhall know it no more.

verses.first: But the merciful goodneſs of the Lord endureth for ever and ever upon them that fear him
verses.second: and his righteouſneſs upon children’s children;

verses.first: Even upon ſuch as keep his covenant
verses.second: and think upon his commandments to do them.

verses.first: The Lord hath prepared his ſeat in heaven
verses.second: and his kingdom ruleth over all.

verses.first: O praiſe the Lord, ye angels of his, ye that excel in ſtrength
verses.second: ye that fulfil his commandment, and hearken unto the voice of his words.

verses.first: O praiſe the Lord, all ye his hoſts
verses.second: ye ſervants of his that do his pleaſure.

verses.first: O ſpeak good of the Lord, all ye works of his, in all places of his dominion
verses.second: praiſe thou the Lord, O my ſoul.

verses.first: PRAISE the Lord, O my ſoul
verses.second: O Lord my God, thou art become exceeding glorious; thou art clothed with majeſty and honour.

verses.first: Thou deckeſt thyſelf with light as it were with a garment
verses.second: and ſpreadeſt out the heavens like a curtain.

verses.first: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters
verses.second: and maketh the clouds his chariot, and walketh upon the wings of the wind.

verses.first: He maketh his angels ſpirits
verses.second: and his miniſters a flaming fire.

verses.first: He laid the foundations of the earth
verses.second: that it never ſhould move at any time.

verses.first: Thou coveredſt it with the deep like as with a garment
verses.second: the waters ſtand in the hills.

verses.first: At thy rebuke they flee
verses.second: at the voice of thy thunder they are afraid.

verses.first: They go up as high as the hills, and down to the valleys beneath
verses.second: even unto the place which thou haſt appointed for them.

verses.first: Thou haſt ſet them their bounds which they ſhall not paſs
verses.second: neither turn again to cover the earth.

verses.first: He ſendeth the ſprings into the rivers
verses.second: which run among the hills.

verses.first: All beaſts of the field drink thereof
verses.second: and the wild aſſes quench their thirſt.

verses.first: Beſide them ſhall the fowls of the air have their habitation
verses.second: and ſing among the branches.

verses.first: He watereth the hills from above
verses.second: the earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.

verses.first: He bringeth forth graſs for the cattle
verses.second: and green herb for the ſervice of men;

verses.first: That he may bring food out of the earth, and wine that maketh glad the heart of man
verses.second: and oil to make him a cheerful countenance, and bread to ſtrengthen man's heart.

verses.first: The trees of the Lord alſo are full of ſap
verses.second: even the cedars of Libanus which he hath planted;

verses.first: Wherein the birds make their neſts
verses.second: and the fir-trees are a dwelling for the ſtork.

verses.first: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats
verses.second: and ſo are the ſtony rocks for the conies.

verses.first: He appointed the moon for certain ſeaſons
verses.second: and the ſun knoweth his going down.

verses.first: Thou makeſt darkneſs that it may be night
verses.second: wherein all the beaſts of the foreſt do move.

verses.first: The lions roaring after their prey
verses.second: do ſeek their meat from God.

verses.first: The ſun ariſeth, and they get them away together
verses.second: and lay them down in their dens.

verses.first: Man goeth forth to his work, and to his labour
verses.second: until the evening.

verses.first: O Lord, how manifold are thy works
verses.second: in wiſdom haſt thou made them all; the earth is full of thy riches.

verses.first: So is the great and wide ſea alſo
verses.second: wherein are things creeping innumerable, both ſmall and great beaſts.

verses.first: There go the ſhips, and there is that Leviathan
verses.second: whom thou haſt made to take his paſtime therein.

verses.first: Theſe wait all upon thee
verses.second: that thou mayeſt give them meat in due ſeaſon.

verses.first: When thou giveſt it them they gather it
verses.second: and when thou openeſt thy hand, they are filled with good.

verses.first: When thou hideſt thy face they are troubled
verses.second: when thou takeſt away their breath they die, and are turned again to their duſt.

verses.first: When thou letteſt thy breath go forth they ſhall be made
verses.second: and thou ſhalt renew the face of the earth.

verses.first: The glorious majeſty of the Lord ſhall endure for ever
verses.second: the Lord ſhall rejoice in his works.

verses.first: The earth ſhall tremble at the look of him
verses.second: if he do but touch the hills, they ſhall ſmoke.

verses.first: I will ſing unto the Lord as long as I live
verses.second: I will praiſe my God while I have my being.

verses.first: And ſo ſhall my words pleaſe him
verses.second: my joy ſhall be in the Lord.

verses.first: As for ſinners, they ſhall be conſumed out of the earth, and the ungodly ſhall come to an end
verses.second: praiſe thou the Lord, O my ſoul, praiſe the Lord.

verses.first: O Give thanks unto the Lord, and call upon his Name
verses.second: tell the people what things he hath done.

verses.first: O let your ſongs be of him, and praiſe him
verses.second: and let your talking be of all his wondrous works.

verses.first: Rejoice in his holy Name
verses.second: let the heart of them rejoice that ſeek the Lord.

verses.first: Seek the Lord and his ſtrength
verses.second: ſeek his face evermore.

verses.first: Remember the marvellous works that he hath done
verses.second: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth.

verses.first: O ye ſeed of Abraham his ſervant
verses.second: ye children of Jacob his choſen.

verses.first: He is the Lord our God
verses.second: his judgments are in all the world.

verses.first: He hath been alway mindful of his covenant and promiſe
verses.second: that he made to a thouſand generations;

verses.first: Even the covenant that he made with Abraham
verses.second: and the oath that he ſware unto Iſaac;

verses.first: And appointed the ſame unto Jacob for a law
verses.second: and to Iſrael for an everlaſting teſtament;

verses.first: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan
verses.second: the lot of your inheritance;

verses.first: When there were yet but a few of them
verses.second: and they ſtrangers in the land;

verses.first: What time as they went from one nation to another
verses.second: from one kingdom to another people;

verses.first: He ſuffered no man to do them wrong
verses.second: but reproved even kings for their ſakes;

verses.first: Touch not mine Anointed
verses.second: and do my prophets no harm.

verses.first: Moreover, he called for a dearth upon the land
verses.second: and deſtroyed all the proviſion of bread.

verses.first: But he had ſent a man before them
verses.second: even Joſeph, who was ſold to be a bondſervant;

verses.first: Whoſe feet they hurt in the ſtocks
verses.second: the iron entered into his ſoul;

verses.first: Until the time came that his cauſe was known
verses.second: the word of the Lord tried him.

verses.first: The king ſent, and delivered him
verses.second: the prince of the people let him go free.

verses.first: He made him lord alſo of his houſe
verses.second: and ruler of all his ſubſtance;

verses.first: That he might inform his princes after his will
verses.second: and teach his ſenators wiſdom.

verses.first: Iſrael alſo came into Egypt
verses.second: and Jacob was a ſtranger in the land of Ham.

verses.first: And he increaſed his people exceedingly
verses.second: and made them ſtronger than their enemies.

verses.first: Whoſe heart turned, ſo that they hated his people
verses.second: and dealt untruly with his ſervants.

verses.first: Then ſent he Moſes his ſervant
verses.second: and Aaron whom he had choſen.

verses.first: And theſe ſhewed his tokens among them
verses.second: and wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.first: He ſent darkneſs, and it was dark
verses.second: and they were not obedient unto his word.

verses.first: He turned their waters into blood
verses.second: and ſlew their fiſh.

verses.first: Their land brought forth frogs
verses.second: yea, even in their king’s chambers.

verses.first: He ſpake the word, and there came all manner of flies
verses.second: and lice in all their quarters.

verses.first: He gave them hailſtones for rain
verses.second: and flames of fire in their land.

verses.first: He ſmote their vines alſo and fig-trees
verses.second: and deſtroyed the trees that were in their coaſts.

verses.first: He ſpake the word, and the graſſhoppers came, and caterpillars innumerable
verses.second: and did eat up all the graſs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

verses.first: He ſmote all the firſt-born in their land
verses.second: even the chief of all their ſtrength.

verses.first: He brought them forth alſo with ſilver and gold
verses.second: there was not one feeble perſon among their tribes.

verses.first: Egypt was glad at their departing
verses.second: for they were afraid of them.

verses.first: He ſpread out a cloud to be a covering
verses.second: and fire to give light in the nightſeaſon.

verses.first: At their deſire he brought quails
verses.second: and he filled them with the bread of heaven.

verses.first: He opened the rock of ſtone, and the waters flowed out
verses.second: ſo that rivers ran in the dry places.

verses.first: For why? he remembered his holy promiſe
verses.second: and Abraham his ſervant.

verses.first: And he brought forth his people with joy
verses.second: and his choſen with gladneſs.

verses.first: And gave them the lands of the heathen
verses.second: and they took the labours of the people in poſſeſſion;

verses.first: That they might keep his ſtatutes
verses.second: and obſerve his laws.

verses.first: O Give thanks unto the Lord, for he is gracious
verses.second: and his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Who can expreſs the noble acts of the Lord
verses.second: or ſhew forth all his praiſe?

verses.first: Bleſſed are they that alway keep judgment
verses.second: and do righteouſneſs.

verses.first: Remember me, O Lord, according to the favour that thou beareſt unto thy people
verses.second: O viſit me with thy ſalvation;

verses.first: That I may ſee the felicity of thy choſen
verses.second: and rejoice in the gladneſs of thy people, and give thanks with thine inheritance.

verses.first: We have ſinned with our fathers
verses.second: we have done amiſs, and dealt wickedly.

verses.first: Our fathers regarded not thy wonders in Egypt, neither kept they thy great goodneſs in remembrance
verses.second: but were diſobedient at the ſea, even at the Red ſea.

verses.first: Nevertheleſs, he helped them for his Name’s ſake
verses.second: that he might make his power to be known.

verses.first: He rebuked the Red ſea alſo, and it was dried up
verses.second: ſo he led them through the deep, as through a wilderneſs.

verses.first: And he ſaved them from the adverſaries hand
verses.second: and delivered them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.first: As for thoſe that troubled them, the waters overwhelmed them
verses.second: there was not one of them left.

verses.first: Then believed they his words
verses.second: and ſang praiſe unto him.

verses.first: But within a while they forgat his works
verses.second: and would not abide his counſel.

verses.first: But luſt came upon them in the wilderneſs
verses.second: and they tempted God in the deſert.

verses.first: And he gave them their deſire
verses.second: and ſent leanneſs withal into their ſoul.

verses.first: They angered Moſes alſo in the tents
verses.second: and Aaron the ſaint of the Lord.

verses.first: So the earth opened, and ſwallowed up Dathan
verses.second: and covered the congregation of Abiram.

verses.first: And the fire was kindled in their company
verses.second: the flame burnt up the ungodly.

verses.first: They made a calf in Horeb
verses.second: and worſhipped the molten image.

verses.first: Thus they turned their glory
verses.second: into the ſimilitude of a calf that eateth hay.

verses.first: And they forgat God their Saviour
verses.second: who had done ſo great things in Egypt;

verses.first: Wondrous works in the land of Ham
verses.second: and fearful things by the Red ſea.

verses.first: So he ſaid, he would have deſtroyed them, had not Moſes his choſen ſtood before him in the gap
verses.second: to turn away his wrathful indignation, leſt he ſhould deſtroy them.

verses.first: Yea, they thought ſcorn of that pleaſant land
verses.second: and gave no credence unto his word;

verses.first: But murmured in their tents
verses.second: and hearkened not unto the voice of the Lord.

verses.first: Then lift he up his hand againſt them
verses.second: to overthrow them in the wilderneſs;

verses.first: To caſt out their ſeed among the nations
verses.second: and to ſcatter them in the lands.

verses.first: They joined themſelves unto Baal-peor
verses.second: and ate the offerings of the dead.

verses.first: Thus they provoked him to anger with their own inventions
verses.second: and the plague was great among them.

verses.first: Then ſtood up Phinees and prayed
verses.second: and ſo the plague ceaſed.

verses.first: And that was counted unto him for righteouſneſs
verses.second: among all poſterities for evermore.

verses.first: They angered him alſo at the waters of ſtrife
verses.second: ſo that he puniſhed Moſes for their ſakes;

verses.first: Becauſe they provoked his ſpirit
verses.second: ſo that he ſpake unadviſedly with his lips.

verses.first: Neither deſtroyed they the heathen
verses.second: as the Lord commanded them;

verses.first: But were mingled among the heathen
verses.second: and learned their works.

verses.first: Inſomuch that they worſhipped their idols, which turned to their own decay
verses.second: yea, they offered their ſons and their daughters unto devils;

verses.first: And ſhed innocent blood, even the blood of their ſons and of their daughters
verses.second: whom they had offered unto the idols of Canaan; and the land was defiled with blood.

verses.first: Thus were they ſtained with their own works
verses.second: and went a whoring with their own inventions.

verses.first: Therefore was the wrath of the Lord kindled againſt his people
verses.second: inſomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

verses.first: And he gave them over into the hands of the heathen
verses.second: and they that hated them, were lords over them.

verses.first: Their enemies oppreſſed them
verses.second: and had them in ſubjection.

verses.first: Many a time did he deliver them
verses.second: but they rebelled againſt him with their own inventions, and were brought down in their wickedneſs.

verses.first: Nevertheleſs, when he ſaw their adverſity
verses.second: he heard their complaint.

verses.first: He thought upon his covenant, and pitied them according unto the multitude of his mercies
verses.second: yea, he made all thoſe that led them away captive to pity them.

verses.first: Deliver us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the heathen
verses.second: that we may give thanks unto thy holy Name, and make our boaſt of thy praiſe.

verses.first: Bleſſed be the Lord God of Iſrael from everlaſting and world without end
verses.second: and let all the people ſay, Amen.

verses.first: O Give thanks unti the Lord, for he is gracious
verses.second: and his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Let them give thanks whom the Lord hath redeemed
verses.second: and delivered from the hand of the enemy;

verses.first: And gathered them out of the lands, from the eaſt, and from the weſt
verses.second: from the north, and from the ſouth.

verses.first: They went aſtray in the wilderneſs out of the way
verses.second: and found no city to dwell in;

verses.first: Hungry and thirſty
verses.second: their ſoul fainted in them.

verses.first: So they cried unto the Lord in their trouble
verses.second: and he delivered them from their diſtreſs.

verses.first: He led them forth by the right way
verses.second: that they might go to the city where they dwelt.

verses.first: O that men would therefore praiſe the Lord for his goodneſs
verses.second: and declare the wonders that he doeth for the children of men!

verses.first: For he ſatiſfieth the empty ſoul
verses.second: and filleth the hungry ſoul with goodneſs.

verses.first: Such as ſit in darkneſs, and in the ſhadow of death
verses.second: being faſt bound in miſery and iron;

verses.first: Becauſe they rebelled againſt the words of the Lord
verses.second: and lightly regarded the counſel of the moſt Higheſt;

verses.first: He alſo brought down their heart through heavineſs
verses.second: they fell down, and there was none to help them.

verses.first: So when they cried unto the Lord in their trouble
verses.second: he delivered them out of their diſtreſs.

verses.first: For he brought them out of darkneſs, and out of the ſhadow of death
verses.second: and brake their bonds in ſunder.

verses.first: O that men would therefore praiſe the Lord for his goodneſs
verses.second: and declare the wonders that he doeth for the children of men!

verses.first: For he hath broken the gates of braſs
verses.second: and ſmitten the bars of iron in ſunder.

verses.first: Fooliſh men are plagued for their offence
verses.second: and becauſe of their wickedneſs.

verses.first: Their ſoul abhorred all manner of meat
verses.second: and they were even hard at death’s door.

verses.first: So when they cried unto the Lord in their trouble
verses.second: he delivered them out of their diſtreſs.

verses.first: He ſent his word, and healed them
verses.second: and they were ſaved from their deſtruction.

verses.first: O that men would therefore praiſe the Lord for his goodneſs
verses.second: and declare the wonders that he doeth for the children of men!

verses.first: That they would offer unto him the ſacrifice of thankſgiving
verses.second: and tell out his works with gladneſs!

verses.first: They that go down to the ſea in ſhips
verses.second: and occupy their buſineſs in great waters;

verses.first: Theſe men ſee the works of the Lord
verses.second: and his wonders in the deep.

verses.first: For at his word the ſtormy wind ariſeth
verses.second: which lifteth up the waves thereof.

verses.first: They are carried up to the heaven, and down again to the deep
verses.second: their ſoul melteth away becauſe of the trouble.

verses.first: They reel to and fro, and ſtagger like a drunken man
verses.second: and are at their witſ' end.

verses.first: So when thy cry unto the Lord in their trouble
verses.second: he delivereth them out of their diſtreſs.

verses.first: For he maketh the ſtorm to ceaſe
verses.second: ſo that the waves thereof are ſtill.

verses.first: Then are they glad, becauſe they are at reſt
verses.second: and ſo he bringeth them unto the haven where they would be.

verses.first: O that men would therefore praiſe the Lord for his goodneſs
verses.second: and declare the wonders that he doeth for the children of men!

verses.first: That they would exalt him alſo in the congregation of the people
verses.second: and praiſe him in the ſeat of the elders!

verses.first: Who turneth the floods into a wilderneſs
verses.second: and drieth up the waterſprings.

verses.first: A fruitful land maketh he barren
verses.second: for the wickedneſs of them that dwell therein.

verses.first: Again, he maketh the wilderneſs a ſtanding water
verses.second: and waterſprings of a dry ground.

verses.first: And there he ſetteth the hungry
verses.second: that they may build them a city to dwell in.

verses.first: That they may ſow their land, and plant vineyards
verses.second: to yield them fruits of increaſe.

verses.first: He bleſſeth them ſo that they multiply exceedingly
verses.second: and ſuffereth not their cattle to decreaſe.

verses.first: And again, when they are mini ſhed and brought low
verses.second: through oppreſſion, through any plague, or trouble;

verses.first: Though he ſuffer them to be evil entreated through tyrants
verses.second: and let them wander out of the way in the wilderneſs.

verses.first: Yet helpeth he the poor out of miſery
verses.second: and maketh him houſeholds like a flock of ſheep.

verses.first: The righteous will conſider this, and rejoice
verses.second: and the mouth of all wickedneſs ſhall be ſtopped.

verses.first: Who ſo is wiſe will ponder theſe things
verses.second: and they ſhall underſtand the loving-kindneſs of the Lord.

verses.first: O God, my heart is ready, my heart is ready
verses.second: I will ſing and give praiſe with the beſt member that I have.

verses.first: Awake, thou lute, and harp
verses.second: I myſelf will awake right early.

verses.first: I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the people
verses.second: I will ſing praiſes unto thee among the nations.

verses.first: For thy mercy is greater than the heavens
verses.second: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds. O

verses.first: Set up thyſelf, O God, above the heavens
verses.second: and thy glory above all the earth.

verses.first: That thy beloved may be delivered
verses.second: let thy right hand ſave them, and hear thou me.

verses.first: God hath ſpoken in his holineſs
verses.second: I will rejoice therefore, and divide Sichem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.first: Gilead is mine, and Manaſſes is mine
verses.second: Ephraim alſo is the ſtrength of my head.

verses.first: Judah is my law-giver, Moab is my waſhpot
verses.second: over Edom will I caſt out my ſhoe, upon Philiſtia will I triumph.

verses.first: Who will lead me into the ſtrong city
verses.second: and who will bring me into Edom?

verses.first: Haſt not thou forſaken us, O God
verses.second: and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hoſts?

verses.first: O help us againſt the enemy
verses.second: for vain is the help of man.

verses.first: Through God we ſhall do great acts
verses.second: and it is he that ſhall tread down our enemies.

verses.first: HOLD not thy tongue, O God of my praiſe
verses.second: for the mouth of the ungodly, yea, the mouth of the deceitful is opened upon me.

verses.first: And they have ſpoken againſt me with falſe tongues
verses.second: they compaſſed me about alſo with words of hatred, and fought againſt me without a cauſe.

verses.first: For the love that I had unto them, lo, they take now my contrary part
verses.second: but I give myſelf unto prayer.

verses.first: Thus have they rewarded me evil for good
verses.second: and hatred for my good will.

verses.first: Set thou an ungodly man to be ruler over him
verses.second: and let Satan ſtand at his right hand.

verses.first: When ſentence is given upon him, let him be condemned
verses.second: and let his prayer be turned into ſin.

verses.first: Let his days be few
verses.second: and let another take his office.

verses.first: Let his children be fatherleſs
verses.second: and his wife a widow.

verses.first: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg their bread
verses.second: let them ſeek it alſo out of deſolate places.

verses.first: Let the extortioner conſume all that he hath
verses.second: and let the ſtranger ſpoil his labour.

verses.first: Let there be no man to pity him
verses.second: nor to have compaſſion upon his fatherleſs children.

verses.first: Let his poſterity be deſtroyed
verses.second: and in the next generation let his name be clean put out.

verses.first: Let the wickedneſs of his fathers be had in remembrance in the ſight of the Lord
verses.second: and let not the ſin of his mother be done away.

verses.first: Let them alway be before the Lord
verses.second: that he may root out the memorial of them from off the earth;

verses.first: And that, becauſe his mind was not to do good
verses.second: but perſecuted the poor helpleſs man, that he might ſlay him that was vexed at the heart.

verses.first: His delight was in curſing, and it ſhall happen unto him
verses.second: he loved not bleſſing, therefore ſhall it be far from him.

verses.first: He clothed himſelf with curſing, like as with a raiment
verses.second: and it ſhall come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

verses.first: Let it be unto him as the cloke that he hath upon him
verses.second: and as the girdle that he is alway girded withal.

verses.first: Let it thus happen from the Lord unto mine enemies
verses.second: and to thoſe that ſpeak evil againſt my ſoul.

verses.first: But deal thou with me, O Lord God, according unto thy Name
verses.second: for ſweet is thy mercy.

verses.first: O deliver me, for I am helpleſs and poor
verses.second: and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.first: I go hence like the ſhadow that departeth
verses.second: and am driven away as the graſshopper.

verses.first: My knees are weak through faſting
verses.second: my fleſh is dried up for want of fatneſs.

verses.first: I became alſo a reproach unto them
verses.second: they that looked upon me ſhaked their heads.

verses.first: Help me, O Lord my God
verses.second: O ſave me according to thy mercy.

verses.first: And they ſhall know, how that this is thy hand
verses.second: and that thou, Lord, haſt done it.

verses.first: Though they curſe, yet bleſs thou
verses.second: and let them be confounded that riſe up againſt me; but let thy ſervant rejoice.

verses.first: Let mine adverſaries be clothed with ſhame
verses.second: and let them cover themſelves with their own confuſion, as with a cloke.

verses.first: As for me, I will give great thanks unto the Lord with my mouth
verses.second: and praiſe him among the multitude.

verses.first: For he ſhall ſtand at the right hand of the poor
verses.second: to ſave his ſoul from the unrighteous judges.

verses.first: THE Lord ſaid unto my Lord
verses.second: Sit thou on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footſtool.

verses.first: The Lord ſhall ſend the rod of thy power out of Sion
verses.second: be thou ruler, even in the midſt among thine enemies.

verses.first: In the day of thy power ſhall the people offer thee free-will offerings with an holy worſhip
verses.second: the dew of thy birth is of the womb of the morning.

verses.first: The Lord ſware, and will not repent
verses.second: Thou art a prieſt for ever after the order of Melchiſedech.

verses.first: The Lord upon thy right hand
verses.second: ſhall wound even kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.first: He ſhall judge among the heathen; he ſhall fill the places with the dead bodies
verses.second: and ſmite in ſunder the heads over divers countries.

verses.first: He ſhall drink of the brook in the way
verses.second: therefore ſhall he lift up his head.

verses.first: I Will give thanks unto the Lord with my whole heart
verses.second: ſecretly among the faithful, and in the congregation.

verses.first: The works of the Lord are great
verses.second: ſought out of all of them that have pleaſure therein.

verses.first: His work is worthy to be praiſed and had in honour
verses.second: and his righteouſneſs endureth for ever.

verses.first: The merciful and gracious Lord hath ſo done his marvellous works
verses.second: that they ought to be had in remembrance.

verses.first: He hath given meat unto them that fear him
verses.second: he ſhall ever be mindful of his covenant.

verses.first: He hath ſhewed his people the power of his works
verses.second: that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

verses.first: The works of his hands are verity and judgment
verses.second: all his commandments are true.

verses.first: They ſtand faſt for ever and ever
verses.second: and are done in truth and equity.

verses.first: He ſent redemption unto his people
verses.second: he hath commanded his covenant for ever; holy and reverend is his Name.

verses.first: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wiſdom
verses.second: a good underſtanding have all they that do thereafter; the praiſe of it endureth for ever.

verses.first: BLESSED is the man that feareth the Lord
verses.second: he hath great delight in his commandments.

verses.first: His ſeed ſhall be mighty upon earth
verses.second: the generation of the faithful ſhall be bleſſed.

verses.first: Riches and plenteouſneſs ſhall be in his houſe
verses.second: and his righteouſneſs endureth for ever.

verses.first: Unto the godly there ariſeth up light in the darkneſs
verses.second: he is merciful, loving, and righteous.

verses.first: A good man is merciful, and lendeth
verses.second: and will guide his words with diſcretion.

verses.first: For he ſhall never be moved
verses.second: and the righteous ſhall be had in everlaſting remembrance.

verses.first: He will not be afraid of any evil tidings
verses.second: for his heart ſtandeth faſt, and believeth in the Lord.

verses.first: His heart is eſtabliſhed, and will not ſhrink
verses.second: until he ſee his deſire upon his enemies.

verses.first: He hath diſperſed abroad, and given to the poor
verses.second: and his righteouſneſs remaineth for ever; his horn ſhall be exalted with honour.

verses.first: The ungodly ſhall ſee it, and it ſhall grieve him
verses.second: he ſhall gnaſh with his teeth, and conſume away; the deſire of the ungodly ſhall periſh.

verses.first: PRAISE the Lord, ye ſervants
verses.second: O praiſe the Name of the Lord.

verses.first: Bleſſed be the Name of the Lord
verses.second: from this time forth for evermore.

verses.first: The Lord’s Name is praiſed
verses.second: from the riſing up of the ſun unto the going down of the ſame.

verses.text: The Lord is high above all heathen and his glory above the heavens.

verses.first: Who is like unto the Lord our God, that hath his dwelling ſo high
verses.second: and yet humbleth himſelf to behold the things that are in heaven and earth?

verses.first: He taketh up the ſimple out of the duſt
