verses.second: and lifteth the poor out of the mire;

verses.first: That he may ſet him with the princes
verses.second: even with the princes of his people.

verses.first: He maketh the barren woman to keep houſe
verses.second: and to be a joyful mother of children.

verses.first: WHEN Iſrael came out of Egypt
verses.second: and the houſe of Jacob from among the ſtrange people.

verses.first: Judah was his ſanctuary
verses.second: and Iſrael his dominion.

verses.first: The ſea ſaw that, and fled
verses.second: Jordan was driven back.

verses.first: The mountains ſkipped like rams
verses.second: and the little hills like young ſheep.

verses.first: What aileth thee, O thou ſea, that thou fleddeſt
verses.second: and thou Jordan, that thou waſt driven back?

verses.first: Ye mountains, that ye ſkipped like rams
verses.second: and ye little hills, like young ſheep?

verses.first: Tremble, thou earth, at the preſence of the Lord
verses.second: at the preſence of the God of Jacob.

verses.first: Who turned the hard rock into a ſtanding water
verses.second: and the flintſtone into a ſpringing well.

verses.first: NOT unto us, O Lord, not unto us, but unto thy Name give the praiſe
verses.second: for thy loving mercy and for thy truth’s ſake.

verses.first: Wherefore ſhall the heathen ſay
verses.second: Where is now their God?

verses.first: As for our God, he is in heaven
verses.second: he hath done whatſoever pleaſed him.

verses.first: Their idols are ſilver and gold
verses.second: even the work of men’s hands.

verses.first: They have mouths, and ſpeak not
verses.second: eyes have they, and ſee not.

verses.first: They have ears, and hear not
verses.second: noſes have they, and ſmell not.

verses.first: They have hands, and handle not; feet have they, and walk not
verses.second: neither ſpeak they through their throat.

verses.first: They that make them are like unto them
verses.second: and ſo are all ſuch as put their truſt in them.

verses.first: But thou, houſe of Iſrael, truſt thou in the Lord
verses.second: he is their ſuccour and defence.

verses.first: Ye houſe of Aaron, put your truſt in the Lord
verses.second: he is their helper and defender.

verses.first: Ye that fear the Lord, put your truſt in the Lord
verses.second: he is their helper and defender.

verses.first: The Lord hath been mindful of us, and he ſhall bleſs us
verses.second: even he ſhall bleſs the houſe of Iſrael, he ſhall bleſs the houſe of Aaron.

verses.first: He ſhall bleſs them that fear the Lord
verses.second: both ſmall and great.

verses.first: The Lord ſhall increaſe you more and more
verses.second: you and your children.

verses.first: Ye are the bleſſed of the Lord
verses.second: who made heaven and earth.

verses.first: All the whole heavens are the Lord’ s
verses.second: the earth hath he given to the children of men.

verses.first: The dead praiſe not thee, O Lord
verses.second: neither all they that go down into ſilence.

verses.first: But we will praiſe the Lord
verses.second: from this time forth for evermore. Praiſe the Lord.

verses.first: I Am well pleaſed
verses.second: that the Lord hath heard the voice of my prayer;

verses.first: That he hath inclined his ear unto me
verses.second: therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

verses.first: The ſnares of death compaſſed me round about
verses.second: and the pains of hell gat hold upon me.

verses.first: I ſhall find trouble and heavineſs, and I will call upon the Name of the Lord
verses.second: O Lord, I beſeech thee, deliver my ſoul.

verses.first: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous
verses.second: yea, our God is merciful

verses.first: The Lord preſerveth the ſimple
verses.second: I was in miſery, and he helped me.

verses.first: Turn again then unto thy reſt, O my ſoul
verses.second: for the Lord hath rewarded thee.

verses.first: And why? thou haſt delivered my ſoul from death
verses.second: mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

verses.first: I will walk before the Lord
verses.second: in the land of the living.

verses.first: I believed, and therefore will I ſpeak; but I was ſore troubled
verses.second: I ſaid in my haſte, All men are liars.

verses.first: What reward ſhall I give unto the Lord
verses.second: for all the benefits that he hath done unto me?

verses.first: I will receive the cup of ſalvation
verses.second: and call upon the Name of the Lord.

verses.first: I will pay my vows now in the preſence of all his people
verses.second: right dear in the ſight of the Lord is the death of his ſaints.

verses.first: Behold, O Lord, how that I am thy ſervant
verses.second: I am thy ſervant, and the ſon of thine handmaid; thou haſt broken my bonds in ſunder.

verses.text: I will offer to thee the ſacrifice of thanksgiving and will call upon the Name of the Lord.

verses.first: I will pay my vows unto the Lord, in the ſight of all his people
verses.second: in the courts of the Lord’s houſe, even in the midſt of thee, O Jeruſalem. Praiſe the Lord.

verses.first: O Praiſe the Lord, all ye heathen
verses.second: praiſe him, all ye nations.

verses.first: For his merciful kindneſs is ever more and more towards us
verses.second: and the truth of the Lord endureth for ever. Praiſe the Lord.

verses.first: O Give thanks unto the Lord, for he is gracious
verses.second: becauſe his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Let Iſrael now confeſs that he is gracious
verses.second: and that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Let the houſe of Aaron now confeſs
verses.second: that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Yea, let them now that fear the Lord confeſs
verses.second: that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: I called upon the Lord in trouble
verses.second: and the Lord heard me at large.

verses.first: The Lord is on my ſide
verses.second: I will not fear what man doeth unto me.

verses.first: The Lord taketh my part with them that help me
verses.second: therefore ſhall I ſee my deſire upon mine enemies.

verses.first: It is better to truſt in the Lord
verses.second: than to put any confidence in man.

verses.first: It is better to truſt in the Lord
verses.second: than to put any confidence in princes.

verses.first: All nations compaſſed me round about
verses.second: but in the Name of the Lord will I deſtroy them.

verses.first: They kept me in on every ſide, they kept me in, I ſay, on every ſide
verses.second: but in the Name of the Lord will I deſtroy them.

verses.first: They came about me like bees, and are extinct even as the fire among the thorns
verses.second: for in the Name of the Lord I will deſtroy them.

verses.first: Thou haſt thruſt ſore at me, that I might fall
verses.second: but the Lord was my help.

verses.first: The Lord is my ſtrength, and my ſong
verses.second: and is become my ſalvation.

verses.first: The voice of joy and health is in the dwellings of the righteous
verses.second: the right hand of the Lord bringeth mighty things to paſs.

verses.first: The right hand of the Lord hath the preeminence
verses.second: the right hand of the Lord bringeth mighty things to paſs.

verses.first: I ſhall not die, but live
verses.second: and declare the works of the Lord.

verses.first: The Lord hath chaſtened and corrected me
verses.second: but he hath not given me over unto death.

verses.first: Open me the gates of righteouſneſs
verses.second: that I may go into them, and give thanks unto the Lord.

verses.first: This is the gate of the Lord
verses.second: the righteous ſhall enter into it.

verses.first: I will thank thee, for thou haſt heard me
verses.second: and art become my ſalvation.

verses.first: The ſame ſtone which the builders refuſed
verses.second: is become the headſtone in the corner.

verses.first: This is the Lord's doing
verses.second: and it is marvellous in our eyes.

verses.first: This is the day which the Lord hath made
verses.second: we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.first: Help me now, O Lord
verses.second: O Lord, ſend us now proſperity.

verses.first: Bleſſed be he that cometh in the Name of the Lord
verses.second: we have wiſhed you good luck, ye that are of the houſe of the Lord.

verses.first: God is the Lord who hath ſhewed us light
verses.second: bind the ſacrifice with cords, yea, even unto the horns of the altar.

verses.first: Thou art my God, and I will thank thee
verses.second: thou art my God, and I will praiſe thee.

verses.first: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is gracious
verses.second: and his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: BLESSED are thoſe that are undefiled in the way
verses.second: and walk in the law of the Lord.

verses.first: Bleſſed are they that keep his teſtimonies
verses.second: and ſeek him with their whole heart.

verses.first: For they who do no wickedneſs
verses.second: walk in his ways.

verses.first: Thou haſt charged
verses.second: that we ſhall diligently keep thy commandments.

verses.first: O that my ways were made ſo direct
verses.second: that I might keep thy ſtatutes!

verses.first: So ſhall I not be confounded
verses.second: while I have reſpect unto all thy commandments.

verses.first: I will thank thee with an unfeigned heart
verses.second: when I ſhall have learned the judgments of thy righteouſneſs.

verses.first: I will keep thy ceremonies
verses.second: O forſake me not utterly.

verses.first: WHEREWITHAL ſhall a young man cleanſe his way
verses.second: even by ruling himſelf after thy word.

verses.first: With my whole heart have I ſought thee
verses.second: O let me not go wrong out of thy commandments.

verses.first: Thy words have I hid within my heart
verses.second: that I ſhould not ſin againſt thee.

verses.first: Bleſſed art thou, O Lord
verses.second: O teach me thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: With my lips have I been telling
verses.second: of all the judgments of thy mouth.

verses.first: I have had as great delight in the way of thy teſtimonies
verses.second: as in all manner of riches.

verses.first: I will talk of thy commandments
verses.second: and have reſpect unto thy ways.

verses.first: My delight ſhall be in thy ſtatutes
verses.second: and I will not forget thy word.

verses.first: O Do well unto thy ſervant
verses.second: that I may live, and keep thy word.

verses.first: Open thou mine eyes
verses.second: that I may ſee the wondrous things of thy law.

verses.first: I am a ſtranger upon earth
verses.second: O hide not thy commandments from me.

verses.first: My ſoul breaketh out for the very fervent deſire
verses.second: that it hath alway unto thy judgments.

verses.first: Thou haſt rebuked the proud
verses.second: and curſed are they that do err from thy commandments.

verses.first: O turn from me ſhame and rebuke
verses.second: for I have kept thy teſtimonies.

verses.first: Princes alſo did ſit and ſpeak againſt me
verses.second: but thy ſervant is occupied in thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: For thy teſtimonies are my delight
verses.second: and my counſellors.

verses.first: MY ſoul cleaveth to the duſt
verses.second: O quicken thou me, according to thy word.

verses.first: I have acknowledged my ways, and thou heardeſt me
verses.second: O teach me thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: Make me to underſtand the way of thy commandments
verses.second: and ſo ſhall I talk of thy wondrous works.

verses.first: My ſoul melteth away for very heavineſs
verses.second: comfort thou me according unto thy word.

verses.first: Take from me the way of lying
verses.second: and cauſe thou me to make much of thy law.

verses.first: I have choſen the way of truth
verses.second: and thy judgments have I laid before me.

verses.first: I have ſtuck unto thy teſtimonies
verses.second: O Lord, confound me not.

verses.first: I will run the way of thy commandments
verses.second: when thou haſt ſet my heart at liberty.

verses.first: TEACH me, O Lord, the way of thy ſtatutes
verses.second: and I ſhall keep it unto the end.

verses.first: Give me underſtanding, and I ſhall keep thy law
verses.second: yea, I ſhall keep it with my whole heart.

verses.first: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments
verses.second: for therein is my deſire.

verses.first: Incline my heart unto thy teſtimonies
verses.second: and not to covetouſneſs.

verses.first: O turn away mine eyes, leſt they behold vanity
verses.second: and quicken thou me in thy way.

verses.first: O ſtabliſh thy word in thy ſervant
verses.second: that I may fear thee.

verses.first: Take away the rebuke that I am afraid of
verses.second: for thy judgments are good.

verses.first: Behold, my delight is in thy commandments
verses.second: O quicken me in thy righteouſneſs.

verses.first: LET thy loving mercy come alſo unto me, O Lord
verses.second: even thy ſalvation, according unto thy word.

verses.first: So ſhall I make anſwer unto my blaſphemers
verses.second: for my truſt is in thy word.

verses.first: O take not the word of thy truth utterly out of my mouth
verses.second: for my hope is in thy judgments.

verses.first: So ſhall I alway keep thy law
verses.second: yea, for ever and ever.

verses.first: And I will walk at liberty
verses.second: for I ſeek thy commandments.

verses.first: I will ſpeak of thy teſtimonies alſo, even before kings
verses.second: and will not be aſhamed.

verses.first: And my delight ſhall be in thy commandments
verses.second: which I have loved.

verses.first: My hands alſo will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved
verses.second: and my ſtudy ſhall be in thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: O Think upon thy ſervant, as concerning thy world
verses.second: wherein thou haſt cauſed me to put my truſt.

verses.first: The ſame is my comfort in my trouble
verses.second: for thy word hath quickened me.

verses.first: The proud have had me exceedingly in deriſion
verses.second: yet have I not ſhrinked from thy law.

verses.first: For I remembered thine everlaſting judgments, O Lord
verses.second: and received comfort.

verses.first: I am horribly afraid
verses.second: for the ungodly that forſake thy law.

verses.first: Thy ſtatutes have been my ſongs
verses.second: in the houſe of my pilgrimage.

verses.first: I have thought upon thy Name, O Lord, in the nightſeaſon
verses.second: and have kept thy law.

verses.first: This I had
verses.second: becauſe I kept thy commandments.

verses.first: THOU art my portion, O Lord
verses.second: I have promiſed to keep thy law.

verses.first: I made my humble petition in thy preſence with my whole heart
verses.second: O be merciful unto me, according to thy word.

verses.first: I called mine own ways to remembrance
verses.second: and turned my feet unto thy teſtimonies.

verses.first: I made haſte, and prolonged not the time
verses.second: to keep thy commandments.

verses.first: The congregations of the ungodly have robbed me
verses.second: but I have not forgotten thy law.

verses.first: At midnight I will riſe to give thanks unto thee
verses.second: becauſe of thy righteous judgments.

verses.first: I am a companion of all them that fear thee
verses.second: and keep thy commandments.

verses.first: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy
verses.second: O teach me thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: O Lord, thou haſt dealt graciouſly with thy ſervant
verses.second: according unto thy word.

verses.first: O learn me true underſtanding and knowledge
verses.second: for I have believed thy commandments.

verses.first: Before I was troubled, I went wrong
verses.second: but now I have kept thy word.

verses.first: Thou art good and gracious
verses.second: O teach me thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: The proud have imagined a lie againſt me
verses.second: but I will keep thy commandments with my whole heart.

verses.first: Their heart is as fat as brawn
verses.second: but my delight hath been in thy law.

verses.first: It is good for me that I have been in trouble
verses.second: that I may learn thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: The law of thy mouth is dearer unto me
verses.second: than thouſands of gold and ſilver.

verses.first: THY hands have made me and faſhioned me
verses.second: O give me underſtanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

verses.first: They that fear thee will be glad when they ſee me
verses.second: becauſe I have put my truſt in thy word.

verses.first: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are right
verses.second: and that thou of very faithfulneſs haſt cauſed me to be troubled.

verses.first: O let thy merciful kindneſs be my comfort
verses.second: according to thy word unto thy ſervant.

verses.first: O let thy loving mercies come unto me, that I may live
verses.second: for thy law is my delight.

verses.first: Let the proud be confounded, for they go wickedly about to deſtroy me
verses.second: but I will be occupied in thy commandments.

verses.first: Let ſuch as fear thee, and have known thy teſtimonies
verses.second: be turned unto me.

verses.first: O let my heart be ſound in thy ſtatutes
verses.second: that I be not aſhamed.

verses.first: MY ſoul hath longed for thy ſalvation
verses.second: and I have a good hope becauſe of thy word.

verses.first: Mine eyes long ſore for thy word
verses.second: ſaying, O when wilt thou comfort me?

verses.first: For I am become like a bottle in the ſmoke
verses.second: yet do I not forget thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: How many are the days of thy ſervant
verses.second: when wilt thou be avenged of them that perſecute me?

verses.first: The proud have digged pits for me
verses.second: which are not after thy law.

verses.first: All thy commandments are true
verses.second: they perſecute me falſely; O be thou my help.

verses.first: They had almoſt made an end of me upon earth
verses.second: but I forſook not thy commandments.

verses.first: O quicken me after thy loving-kindneſs
verses.second: and ſo ſhall I keep the teſtimonies of thy mouth.

verses.first: O Lord, thy word
verses.second: endureth for ever in heaven.

verses.first: Thy truth alſo remaineth from one generation to another
verses.second: thou haſt laid the foundation of the earth, and it abideth.

verses.first: They continue this day according to thine ordinance
verses.second: for all things ſerve thee.

verses.first: If my delight had not been in thy law
verses.second: I ſhould have periſhed in my trouble.

verses.first: I will never forget thy commandments
verses.second: for with them thou haſt quickened me.

verses.first: I am thine, O ſave me
verses.second: for I have ſought thy commandments.

verses.first: The ungodly laid wait for me to deſtroy me
verses.second: but I will conſider thy teſtimonies.

verses.first: I ſee that all things come to an end
verses.second: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

verses.first: LORD, what love have I unto thy law
verses.second: all the day long is my ſtudy in it.

verses.first: Thou through thy commandments haſt made me wiſer than mine enemies
verses.second: for they are ever with me.

verses.first: I have more underſtanding than my teachers
verses.second: for thy teſtimonies are my ſtudy.

verses.first: I am wiſer than the aged
verses.second: becauſe I keep thy commandments.

verses.first: I have refrained my feet from every evil way
verses.second: that I may keep thy word.

verses.first: I have not ſhrunk from thy judgments
verses.second: for thou teacheſt me.

verses.first: O how ſweet are thy words unto my throat
verses.second: yea, ſweeter than honey unto my mouth.

verses.first: Through thy commandments I get underſtanding
verses.second: therefore I hate all evil ways.

verses.first: THY word is a lantern unto my feet
verses.second: and a light unto my paths.

verses.first: I have ſworn, and am ſtedfaſtly purpoſed
verses.second: to keep thy righteous judgments.

verses.first: I am troubled above meaſure
verses.second: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy word.

verses.first: Let the free-will offerings of my mouth pleaſe thee, O Lord
verses.second: and teach me thy judgments.

verses.first: My ſoul is always in my hand
verses.second: yet do I not forget thy law.

verses.first: The ungodly have laid a ſnare for me
verses.second: but yet I ſwerved not from thy commandments.

verses.first: Thy teſtimonies have I claimed as mine heritage for ever
verses.second: and why? they are the very joy of my heart.

verses.first: I have applied my heart to fulfil thy ſtatutes alway
verses.second: even unto the end.

verses.first: I Hate them that imagine evil things
verses.second: but thy law do I love.

verses.first: Thou art my defence and ſhield
verses.second: and my truſt is in thy word.

verses.first: Away from me, ye wicked
verses.second: I will keep the commandments of my God.

verses.first: O ſtabliſh me according to thy word, that I may live
verses.second: and let me not be diſappointed of my hope.

verses.first: Hold thou me up, and I ſhall be ſafe
verses.second: yea, my delight ſhall be ever in thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: Thou haſt trodden down all them that depart from thy ſtatutes
verses.second: for they imagine but deceit.

verses.first: Thou putteſt away all the ungodly of the earth like droſs
verses.second: therefore I love thy teſtimonies.

verses.first: My fleſh trembleth for fear of thee
verses.second: and I am afraid of thy judgments.

verses.first: I Deal with the thing that is lawful and right
verses.second: O give me not over unto mine oppreſſors.

verses.first: Make thou thy ſervant to delight in that which is good
verses.second: that the proud do me no wrong.

verses.first: Mine eyes are waſted away with looking for thy health
verses.second: and for the word of thy righteouſneſs.

verses.first: O deal with thy ſervant according unto thy loving mercy
verses.second: and teach me thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: I am thy ſervant, O grant me underſtanding
verses.second: that I may know thy teſtimonies.

verses.first: It is time for thee, Lord to lay to thine hand
verses.second: for they have deſtroyed thy law.

verses.first: For I love thy commandments
verses.second: above gold and precious ſtone.

verses.first: Therefore hold I ſtraight all thy commandments
verses.second: and all falſe ways I utterly abhor.

verses.first: THY teſtimonies are wonderful
verses.second: therefore doth my ſoul keep them.

verses.first: When thy word goeth forth
verses.second: it giveth light and underſtanding unto the ſimple.

verses.first: I opened my mouth, and drew in my breath
verses.second: for my delight was in thy commandments.

verses.first: O look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me
verses.second: as thou uſeſt to do unto thoſe that love thy Name.

verses.first: Order my ſteps in thy word
verses.second: and ſo ſhall no wickedneſs have dominion over me.

verses.first: O deliver me from the wrongful dealings of men
verses.second: and ſo ſhall I keep thy commandments.

verses.first: Shew the light of thy countenance upon thy ſervant
verses.second: and teach me thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: Mine eyes guſh out with water
verses.second: becauſe men keep not thy law.

verses.first: RIGHTEOUS art thou, O Lord
verses.second: and true is thy judgment.

verses.first: The teſtimonies that thou haſt commanded
verses.second: are exceeding righteous and true.

verses.first: My zeal hath even conſumed me
verses.second: becauſe mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

verses.first: Thy word is tried to the uttermoſt
verses.second: and thy ſervant loveth it.

verses.first: I am ſmall, and of no reputation
verses.second: yet do I not forget thy commandments.

verses.first: Thy righteouſneſs is an everlaſting righteouſneſs
verses.second: and thy law is the truth.

verses.first: Trouble and heavineſs have taken hold upon me
verses.second: yet is my delight in thy commandments.

verses.first: The righteouſneſs of thy teſtimonies is everlaſting
verses.second: O grant me underſtanding, and I ſhall live.

verses.first: I Call with my whole heart
verses.second: hear me, O Lord, I will keep thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: Yea, even unto thee do I call
verses.second: help me, and I ſhall keep thy teſtimonies.

verses.first: Early in the morning do I cry unto thee
verses.second: for in thy word is my truſt.

verses.first: Mine eyes prevent the night-watches
verses.second: that I might be occupied in thy words.

verses.first: Hear my voice, O Lord, according unto my loving-kindneſs
verses.second: quicken me, according as thou art wont.

verses.first: They draw nigh that of malice perſecute me
verses.second: and are far from thy law.

verses.first: Be thou nigh at hand, O Lord
verses.second: for all thy commandments are true.

verses.first: As concerning thy teſtimonies, I have known long ſince
verses.second: that thou haſt grounded them for ever.

verses.first: O Conſider mine adverſity, and deliver me
verses.second: for I do not forget thy law.

verses.first: Avenge thou my cauſe, and deliver me
verses.second: quicken me, according to thy word.

verses.first: Health is far from the ungodly
verses.second: for they regard not thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: Great is thy mercy, O Lord
verses.second: quicken me, as thou art wont.

verses.first: Many there are that trouble me, and perſecute me
verses.second: yet do I not ſwerve from thy teſtimonies.

verses.first: It grieveth me when I ſee the tranſgreſſors
verses.second: becauſe they keep not thy law.

verses.first: Conſider, O Lord, how I love thy commandments
verses.second: O quicken me, according to thy loving-kindneſs.

verses.first: Thy word is true from everlaſting
verses.second: all the judgments of thy righteouſneſs endure for evermore.

verses.first: PRINCES have perſecuted me without a cauſe
verses.second: but my heart ſtandeth in awe of thy word.

verses.first: I am as glad of thy word
verses.second: as one that findeth great ſpoils.

verses.first: As for lies, I hate and abhor them
verses.second: but thy law do I love.

verses.first: Seven times a day do I praiſe thee
verses.second: becauſe of thy righteous judgments.

verses.first: Great is the peace that they have who love thy law
verses.second: and they are not offended at it.

verses.first: Lord, I have looked for thy ſaving health
verses.second: and done after thy commandments.

verses.first: My ſoul hath kept thy teſtimonies
verses.second: and loved them exceedingly.

verses.first: I have kept thy commandments and teſtimonies
verses.second: for all my ways are before thee.

verses.first: LET my complaint come before thee, O Lord
verses.second: give me underſtanding, according to thy word.

verses.first: Let my ſupplication come before thee
verses.second: deliver me, according to thy word.

verses.first: My lips ſhall ſpeak of thy praiſe
verses.second: when thou haſt taught me thy ſtatutes.

verses.first: Yea, my tongue ſhall ſing of thy word
verses.second: for all thy commandments are righteous.

verses.first: Let thine hand help me
verses.second: for I have choſen thy commandments.

verses.first: I have longed for thy ſaving health, O Lord
verses.second: and in thy law is my delight.

verses.first: O let my ſoul live, and it ſhall praiſe thee
verses.second: and thy judgments ſhall help me.

verses.first: I have gone aſtray like a ſheep that is loſt
verses.second: O ſeek thy ſervant, for I do not forget thy commandments.

verses.first: WHENI was in trouble I called upon the Lord
verses.second: and he heard me.

verses.first: Deliver my ſoul, O Lord, from lying lips
verses.second: and from a deceitful tongue.

verses.first: What reward ſhall be given or done unto thee, thou falſe tongue
verses.second: even mighty and ſharp arrows, with hot burning coals.

verses.first: Woe is me, that I am conſtrained to dwell with Meſech
verses.second: and to have my habitation among the tents of Kedar.

verses.first: My ſoul hath long dwelt among them
verses.second: that are enemies unto peace.

verses.first: I labour for peace, but when I ſpeak unto them thereof
verses.second: they make them ready to battle.

verses.first: I Will lift up mine eyes unto the hills
verses.second: from whence cometh my help.

verses.first: My help cometh even from the Lord
verses.second: who hath made heaven and earth.

verses.first: He will not ſuffer thy foot to be moved
verses.second: and he that keepeth thee will not ſleep.

verses.first: Behold, he that keepeth Iſrael
verses.second: ſhall neither ſlumber nor ſleep.

verses.first: The Lord himſelf is thy keeper
verses.second: the Lord is thy defence upon thy right hand;

verses.first: So that the ſun ſhall not burn thee by day
verses.second: neither the moon by night. W I

verses.first: The Lord ſhall preſerve thee from all evil
verses.second: yea, it is even he that ſhall keep thy ſoul.

verses.first: The Lord ſhall preſerve thy going out, and thy coming in
verses.second: from this time forth for evermore.

verses.first: I Was glad when they ſaid unto me
verses.second: We will go into the houſe of the Lord.

verses.first: Our feet ſhall ſtand in thy gates
verses.second: O Jeruſalem.

verses.first: Jeruſalem is built as a city
verses.second: that is at unity in itſelf.

verses.first: For thither the tribes go up, even the tribes of the Lord
verses.second: to teſtify unto Iſrael, to give thanks unto the Name of the Lord.

verses.first: For there is the ſeat of judgment
verses.second: even the ſeat of the houſe of David.

verses.first: O pray for the peace of Jeruſalem
verses.second: they ſhall proſper that love thee.

verses.first: Peace be within thy walls
verses.second: and plenteouſneſs within thy palaces.

verses.first: For my brethren and companions ſakes
verses.second: I will wiſh thee proſperity.

verses.first: Yea, becauſe of the houſe of the Lord our God
verses.second: I will ſeek to do thee good.

verses.first: UNTO thee lift I up mine eyes
verses.second: O thou that dwelleſt in the heavens.

verses.first: Behold, even as the eyes of ſervants look unto the hand of their maſters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her miſtreſs
verses.second: even ſo our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until he have mercy upon us.

verses.first: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us
verses.second: for we are utterly deſpiſed.

verses.first: Our ſoul is filled with the ſcornful reproof of the wealthy
verses.second: and with the deſpitefulneſs of the proud.

verses.first: IF the Lord himſelf had not been on our ſide, now may Iſrael ſay
verses.second: if the Lord himſelf had not been on our ſide, when men roſe up againſt us;

verses.first: They had ſwallowed us up quick
verses.second: when thy were ſo wrathfully diſpleaſed at us.

verses.first: Yea, the waters had drowned us
verses.second: and the ſtream had gone over our ſoul.

verses.first: The deep waters of the proud
verses.second: had gone even over our ſoul.

verses.first: But praiſed be the Lord
verses.second: who hath not given us over for a prey unto their teeth.

verses.first: Our ſoul is eſcaped even as a bird out of the ſnare of the fowler
verses.second: the ſnare is broken, and we are delivered .

verses.first: Our help ſtandeth in the Name of the Lord
verses.second: who hath made heaven and earth.

verses.first: THEY that put their truſt in the Lord, ſhall be even as the mount Sion
verses.second: which may not be removed, but ſtandeth faſt for ever.

verses.first: The hills ſtand about Jeruſalem
verses.second: even ſo ſtandeth the Lord round about his people, from this time forth for evermore.

verses.first: For the rod of the ungodly cometh not into the lot of the righteous
verses.second: leſt the righteous put their hand unto wickedneſs.

verses.first: Do well, O Lord
verses.second: unto thoſe that are good and true of heart.

verses.first: As for ſuch as turn back unto their own wickedneſs
verses.second: the Lord ſhall lead them forth with the evil-doers; but peace ſhall be upon Iſrael.

verses.first: WHEN the Lord turned again the captivity of Sion
verses.second: then were we like unto them that dream.

verses.first: Then was our mouth filled with laughter
verses.second: and our tongue with joy.

verses.first: Then ſaid they among the heathen
verses.second: The Lord hath done great things for them.

verses.first: Yea, the Lord hath done great things for us already
verses.second: whereof we rejoice.

verses.first: Turn our captivity, O Lord
verses.second: as the rivers in the ſouth.

verses.first: They that ſow in tears
verses.second: ſhall reap in joy.

verses.first: He that now goeth on his way weeping, and beareth forth good ſeed
verses.second: ſhall doubtleſs come again with joy, and bring his ſheaves with him.

verses.first: EXCEPT the Lord build the houſe
verses.second: their labour is but loſt that build it.

verses.first: Except the Lord keep the city
verses.second: the watchman waketh but in vain.

verses.first: It is but loſt labour that ye haſte to riſe up early, and ſo late take reſt, and eat the bread of carefulneſs
verses.second: for ſo he giveth his beloved ſleep.

verses.first: Lo, children and the fruit of the womb
verses.second: are an heritage and gift that cometh of the Lord.

verses.first: Like as the arrows in the hand of the giant
verses.second: even ſo are the young children.

verses.first: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them
verses.second: they ſhall not be aſhamed when they ſpeak with their enemies in the gate.

verses.first: BLESSED are all they that fear the Lord
verses.second: and walk in his ways.

verses.first: For thou ſhalt eat the labour of thine hands
verses.second: O well is thee, and happy ſhalt thou be.

verses.first: Thy wife ſhall be as the fruitful vine
verses.second: upon the walls of thine houſe;

verses.first: Thy children like the olive-branches
verses.second: round about thy table.

verses.first: Lo, thus ſhall the man be bleſſed
verses.second: that feareth the Lord.

verses.first: The Lord from out of Sion ſhall ſo bleſs thee
verses.second: that thou ſhalt ſee Jeruſalem in proſperity all thy life long.

verses.first: Yea, that thou ſhalt ſee thy children’s children
verses.second: and peace upon Iſrael.

verses.first: MANY a time have they fought againſt me from my youth up
verses.second: may Iſrael now ſay.

verses.first: Yea, many a time have they vexed me from my youth up
verses.second: but they have not prevailed againſt me.

verses.first: The plowers plowed upon my back
verses.second: and made long furrows.

verses.first: But the righteous Lord
verses.second: hath hewn the ſnares of the ungodly in pieces.

verses.first: Let them be confounded and turned backward
verses.second: as many as have evil will at Sion.

verses.first: Let them be even as the graſs growing upon the houſe-tops
verses.second: which withereth afore it be plucked up;

verses.first: Whereof the mower filleth not his hand
verses.second: neither he that bindeth up the ſheaves his boſom.

verses.first: So that they who go by, ſay not ſo much as, The Lord proſper you
verses.second: we wiſh you good luck in the Name of the Lord.

verses.first: OUT of the deep have I called unto thee, O Lord
verses.second: Lord, hear my voice.

verses.first: O let thine ears conſider well
verses.second: the voice of my complaint.

verses.first: If thou, Lord, wilt be extreme to mark what is done amiſs
verses.second: O Lord, who may abide it?

verses.first: For there is mercy with thee
verses.second: therefore ſhalt thou be feared.

verses.first: I look for the Lord; my ſoul doth wait for him
verses.second: in his word is my truſt.

verses.first: My ſoul fleeth unto the Lord
verses.second: before the morning watch, I ſay, before the morning watch.

verses.first: O Iſrael, truſt in the Lord, for with the Lord there is mercy
verses.second: and with him is plenteous redemption.

verses.first: And he ſhall redeem Iſrael
verses.second: from all his ſins.

verses.first: LORD, I am not high-minded
verses.second: I have no proud looks.

verses.first: I do not exerciſe myſelf in great matters
verses.second: which are too high for me;

verses.first: But I refrain my ſoul, and keep it low, like as a child that is weaned from his mother
verses.second: yea, my ſoul is even as a weaned child.

verses.first: O Iſrael, truſt in the Lord
verses.second: from this time forth for evermore.

verses.first: LORD, remember David
verses.second: and all his trouble;

verses.first: How he ſware unto the Lord
verses.second: and vowed a vow unto the Almighty God of Jacob;

verses.first: I will not come within the tabernacle of mine houſe
verses.second: nor climb up into my bed;

verses.first: I will not ſuffer mine eyes to ſleep, nor mine eye-lids to ſlumber
verses.second: neither the temples of my head to take any reſt;

verses.first: Until I find out a place for the temple of the Lord
verses.second: an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

verses.first: Lo, we heard of the ſame at Ephrata
verses.second: and found it in the wood.

verses.first: We will go into his tabernacle
verses.second: and fall low on our knees before his footſtool.

verses.first: Ariſe, O Lord, into thy reſting-place
verses.second: thou, and the ark of thy ſtrength.

verses.first: Let thy prieſts be clothed with righteouſneſs
verses.second: and let thy ſaints ſing with joyfulneſs.

verses.first: For thy ſervant David’s ſake
verses.second: turn not away the preſence of thine Anointed.

verses.first: The Lord hath made a faithful oath unto David
verses.second: and he ſhall not ſhrink from it;

verses.first: Of the fruit of thy body
verses.second: ſhall I ſet upon thy ſeat.

verses.first: If thy children will keep my covenant, and my teſtimonies that I ſhall learn them
verses.second: their children alſo ſhall ſit upon thy ſeat for evermore.

verses.first: For the Lord hath choſen Sion to be an habitation for himſelf
verses.second: he hath longed for her.

verses.first: This ſhall be my reſt for ever
verses.second: here will I dwell, for I have a delight therein.

verses.first: I will bleſs her victuals with increaſe
verses.second: and will ſatiſfy her poor with bread.

verses.first: I will deck her prieſts with health
verses.second: and her ſaints ſhall rejoice and ſing.

verses.first: There ſhall I make the horn of David to flouriſh
verses.second: I have ordained a lantern for mine Anointed.

verses.first: As for his enemies, I ſhall clothe them with ſhame
verses.second: but upon himſelf ſhall his crown flouriſh.

verses.first: BEHOLD, how good and joyful a thing it is
verses.second: brethren, to dwell together in unity!

verses.first: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down unto the beard
verses.second: even unto Aaron’s beard, and went down to the ſkirts of his clothing.

verses.first: Like as the dew of Hermon
verses.second: which fell upon the hill of Sion.

verses.first: For there the Lord promiſed his bleſſing
verses.second: and life for evermore.

verses.first: BEHOLD now, praiſe the Lord
verses.second: all ye ſervants of the Lord;

verses.first: Ye that by night ſtand in the houſe of the Lord
verses.second: even in the courts of the houſe of our God.

verses.first: Lift up your hands in the ſanctuary
verses.second: and praiſe the Lord.

verses.first: The Lord that made heaven and earth
verses.second: give thee bleſſing out of Sion.

verses.first: O Praiſe the Lord, laud ye the Name of the Lord
verses.second: praiſe it, O ye ſervants of the Lord;

verses.first: Ye that ſtand in the houſe of the Lord
verses.second: in the courts of the houſe of our God.

verses.first: O praiſe the Lord, for the Lord is gracious
verses.second: O ſing praiſes unto his Name, for it is lovely.

verses.first: For why? the Lord hath choſen Jacob unto himſelf
verses.second: and Iſrael for his own poſſeſſion.

verses.first: For I know that the Lord is great
verses.second: and that our Lord is above all gods.

verses.first: Whatſoever the Lord pleaſed, that did he in heaven and in earth
verses.second: and in the ſea, and in all deep places.

verses.first: He bringeth forth the clouds from the ends of the world
verses.second: and ſendeth forth lightnings with the rain, bringing the winds out of his treaſures.

verses.first: He ſmote the firſt-born of Egypt
verses.second: both of man and beaſt.

verses.first: He hath ſent tokens and wonders into the midſt of thee, O thou land of Egypt
verses.second: upon Pharaoh, and all his ſervants.

verses.first: He ſmote divers nations
verses.second: and ſlew mighty kings;

verses.first: Sehon king of the Amorites, and Og the king of Baſan
verses.second: and all the kingdoms of Canaan;

verses.first: And gave their land to be an heritage
verses.second: even an heritage unto Iſrael his people.

verses.first: Thy Name, O Lord, endureth for ever
verses.second: ſo doth thy memorial, O Lord, from one generation to another.

verses.first: For the Lord will avenge his people
verses.second: and be gracious unto his ſervants.

verses.first: As for the images of the heathen, they are but ſilver and gold
verses.second: the work of men’s hands.

verses.first: They have mouths, and ſpeak not
verses.second: eyes have they, but they ſee not.

verses.first: They have ears, and yet they hear not
verses.second: neither is there any breath in their mouths.

verses.first: They that make them are like unto them
verses.second: and ſo are all they that put their truſt in them.

verses.first: Praiſe the Lord, ye houſe of Iſrael
verses.second: praiſe the Lord, ye houſe of Aaron.

verses.first: Praiſe the Lord, ye houſe of Levi
verses.second: ye that fear the Lord, praiſe the Lord.

verses.first: Praiſed be the Lord out of Sion
verses.second: who dwelleth at Jeruſalem.

verses.first: O Give thanks unto the Lord, for he is gracious
verses.second: and his mercy endures for ever.

verses.first: O give thanks unto the God of all gods
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: O thank the Lord of all lords
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Who only doeth great wonders
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Who by his excellent wiſdom made the heavens
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Who laid out the earth above the waters
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Who hath made great lights
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.first: The ſun to rule the day
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.first: The moon and the ſtars to govern the night
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Who ſmote Egypt with their firſt-born
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.first: And brought out Iſrael from among them
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.first: With a mighty hand, and ſtretched-out arm
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Who divided the Red ſea in two parts
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.first: And made Iſrael to go through the midſt of it
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: But as for Pharaoh and his hoſt, he overthrew them in the Red ſea
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Who led his people through the wilderneſs
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Who ſmote great kings
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.first: Yea, and ſlew mighty kings
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.first: Sehon king of the Amorites
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.first: And Og the king of Baſan
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.first: And gave away their land for an heritage
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.first: Even for an heritage unto Iſrael his ſervant
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Who remembered us when we were in trouble
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.first: And hath delivered us from our enemies
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: Who giveth food to all fleſh
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: O give thanks unto the God of heaven
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: O give thanks unto the Lord of lords
verses.second: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.first: BY the waters of Babylon we ſat down and wept
verses.second: when we remembered thee, O Sion.

verses.first: As for our harps, we hanged them up
verses.second: upon the trees that are therein.

verses.first: For they that led us away captive required of us then a ſong, and melody in our heavineſs
verses.second: Sing us one of the ſongs of Sion.

verses.first: How ſhall we ſing the Lord’s ſong
verses.second: in a ſtrange land?

verses.first: If I forget thee, O Jeruſalem
verses.second: let my right hand forget her cunning.

verses.first: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth
verses.second: yea, if I prefer not Jeruſalem in my mirth.

verses.first: Remember the children of Edom, O Lord, in the day of Jeruſalem
verses.second: how they ſaid, Down with it, down with it, even to the ground.

verses.first: O daughter of Babylon, waſted with miſery
verses.second: yea, happy ſhall he be that rewardeth thee, as thou haſt ſerved us.

verses.first: Bleſſed ſhall he be that taketh thy children
verses.second: and throweth them againſt the ſtones.

verses.first: I Will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, with my whole heart
verses.second: even before the gods will I ſing praiſe unto thee.

verses.first: I will worſhip toward thy holy temple, and praiſe thy Name, becauſe of thy lovingkindneſs and truth
verses.second: for thou haſt magnified thy Name and thy word above all things.

verses.first: When I called upon thee, thou heardeſt me
verses.second: and enduedſt my ſoul with much ſtrength.

verses.first: All the kings of the earth ſhall praiſe thee, O Lord
verses.second: for they have heard the words of thy mouth.

verses.first: Yea, they ſhall ſing in the ways of the Lord
verses.second: that great is the glory of the Lord.

verses.first: For though the Lord be high, yet hath he reſpect unto the lowly
verses.second: as for the proud, he beholdeth them afar off.

verses.first: Though I walk in the midſt of trouble, yet ſhalt thou refreſh me
verses.second: thou ſhalt ſtretch forth thy hand upon the furiouſneſs of mine enemies, and thy right hand ſhall ſave me.

verses.first: The lord ſhall make good his lovingkindneſs toward me
verses.second: yea, thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever; deſpiſe not then the works of thine own hands.

verses.first: O Lord, thou haſt ſearched me out and known me
verses.second: thou knoweſt my downſitting, and mine up-riſing; thou underſtandeſt my thoughts long before.

verses.first: Thou art about my path, and about my bed
verses.second: and ſpieſt out all my ways.

verses.first: For lo, there is not a word in my tongue
verses.second: but thou, O Lord, knoweſt it altogether.

verses.first: Thou haſt faſhioned me behind and before
verses.second: and laid thine hand upon me.

verses.first: Such knowledge is too wonderful and excellent for me
verses.second: I cannot attain unto it.

verses.first: Whither ſhall I go then from thy Spirit
verses.second: or whither ſhall I go then from thy preſence?

verses.first: If I climb up into heaven, thou art there
verses.second: if I go down to hell, thou art there alſo.

verses.first: If I take the wings of the morning
verses.second: and remain in the uttermoſt parts of the ſea;

verses.first: Even there alſo ſhall thy hand lead me
verses.second: and thy right hand ſhall hold me.

verses.first: If I ſay, Peradventure the darkneſs ſhall cover me
verses.second: then ſhall my night be turned to day.

verses.first: Yea, the darkneſs is no darkneſs with thee, but the night is as clear as the day
verses.second: the darkneſs and light to thee are both alike.

verses.first: For my reins are thine
verses.second: thou haſt covered me in my mother’s womb.

verses.first: I will give thanks unto thee, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made
verses.second: marvellous are thy works, and that my ſoul knoweth right well.

verses.first: My bones are not hid from thee
verses.second: though I be made ſecretly, and faſhioned beneath in the earth.

verses.first: Thine eyes did ſee my ſubſtance, yet being unperfect
verses.second: and in thy book were all my members written;

verses.first: Which day by day were faſhioned
verses.second: when as yet there was none of them.

verses.first: How dear are thy counſels unto me, O God
verses.second: O how great is the ſum of them!

verses.first: If I tell them, they are more in number than the ſand
verses.second: when I wake up I am preſent with thee.

verses.first: Wilt thou not ſlay the wicked, O God
verses.second: depart from me, ye blood-thirſty men.

verses.first: For they ſpeak unrighteouſly againſt thee
verses.second: and thine enemies take thy Name in vain.

verses.first: Do not I hate them, O Lord, that hate thee
verses.second: and am not I grieved with thoſe that riſe up againſt thee?

verses.first: Yea, I hate them right ſore
verses.second: even as though they were mine enemies.

verses.first: Try me, O God, and ſeek the ground of my heart
verses.second: prove me, and examine my thoughts.

verses.first: Look well if there be any way of wickedneſs in me
verses.second: and lead me in the way everlaſting.

verses.first: DELIVER me, O Lord, from the evil man
verses.second: and preſerve me from the wicked man.

verses.first: Who imagine miſchief in their hearts
verses.second: and ſtir up ſtrife all the day long.

verses.first: They have ſharpened their tongues like a ſerpent
verses.second: adder’s poiſon is under their lips.

verses.first: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the ungodly
verses.second: preſerve me from the wicked men, who are purpoſed to overthrow my goings.

verses.first: The proud have laid a ſnare for me, and ſpread a net abroad with cords
verses.second: yea, and ſet traps in my way.

verses.first: I ſaid unto the Lord, Thou art my God
verses.second: hear the voice of my prayers, O Lord. D

verses.first: O Lord God, thou ſtrength of my health
verses.second: thou haſt covered my head in the day of the battle.

verses.first: Let not the ungodly have his deſire, O Lord
verses.second: let not his miſchievous imagination proſper, leſt they be too proud.

verses.first: Let the miſchief of their own lips fall upon the head of them
verses.second: that compaſs me about.

verses.first: Let hot burning coals fall upon them
verses.second: let them be caſt into the fire, and into the pit, that they never riſe up again.

verses.first: A man full of words ſhall not proſper upon the earth
verses.second: evil ſhall hunt the wicked perſon to overthrow him.

verses.first: Sure I am that the Lord will avenge the poor
verses.second: and maintain the cauſe of the helpleſs.

verses.first: The righteous alſo ſhall give thanks unto thy Name
verses.second: and the juſt ſhall continue in thy ſight.

verses.first: LORD, I call upon thee, haſte thee unto me
verses.second: and conſider my voice, when I cry unto thee.

verses.first: Let my prayer be ſet forth in thy ſight as the incenſe
verses.second: and let the lifting up of my hands be an evening ſacrifice.

verses.first: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth
verses.second: and keep the door of my lips.

verses.first: O let not mine heart be inclined to any evil thing
verses.second: let me not be occupied in ungodly works with the men that work wickedneſs, leſt I eat of ſuch things as pleaſe them.

verses.first: Let the righteous rather ſmite me friendly
verses.second: and reprove me.

verses.first: But let not their precious balms break my head
verses.second: yea, I will pray yet againſt their wickedneſs.

verses.first: Let their judges be overthrown in ſtony places
verses.second: that they may hear my words, for they are ſweet.

verses.first: Our bones lie ſcattered before the pit
verses.second: like as when one breaketh and heweth wood upon the earth.

verses.first: But mine eyes look unto thee, O Lord God
verses.second: in thee is my truſt , O caſt not out my ſoul.

verses.first: Keep me from the ſnare that they have laid for me
verses.second: and from the traps of the wicked doers.

verses.first: Let the ungodly fall into their own nets together
verses.second: and let me ever eſcape them.

verses.first: I Cried unto the Lord with my voice
verses.second: yea, even unto the Lord did I make my ſupplication.

verses.first: I poured out my complaints before him
verses.second: and ſhewed him of my trouble.

verses.first: When my ſpirit was in heavineſs, thou kneweſt my path
verses.second: in the way wherein I walked, have they privily laid a ſnare for me.

verses.first: I looked alſo upon my right hand
verses.second: and ſaw there was no man that would know me.

verses.first: I had no place to flee unto
verses.second: and no man cared for my ſoul.

verses.first: I cried unto thee, O Lord, and ſaid
verses.second: Thou art my hope, and my portion in the land of the living.

verses.first: Conſider my complaint
verses.second: for I am brought very low.

verses.first: O deliver me from my perſecutors
verses.second: for they are too ſtrong for me.

verses.first: Bring my ſoul out of priſon, that I may give thanks unto thy Name
verses.second: which thing if thou wilt grant me, then ſhall the righteous reſort unto my company.

verses.first: HEAR my prayer, O Lord, and conſider my deſire
verses.second: hearken unto me for thy truth and righteouſneſs ſake.

verses.first: And enter not into judgment with thy ſervant
verses.second: for in thy ſight ſhall no man living be juſtified.

verses.first: For the enemy hath perſecuted my ſoul; he hath ſmitten my life down to the ground
verses.second: he hath laid me in the darkneſs, as the men that have been long dead.

verses.first: Therefore is my ſpirit vexed within me
verses.second: and my heart within me is deſolate.

verses.first: Yet do I remember the time paſt; I muſe upon all thy works
verses.second: yea, I exerciſe myſelf in the works of thy hands.

verses.first: I ſtretch forth my hands unto thee
verses.second: my ſoul gaſpeth unto thee as a thirſty land.

verses.first: Hear me, O Lord, and that ſoon, for my ſpirit waxeth faint
verses.second: hide not thy face from me, leſt I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

verses.first: O let me hear thy loving-kindneſs betimes in the morning, for in thee is my truſt
verses.second: ſhew thou me the way that I ſhould walk in, for I lift up my ſoul unto thee.

verses.first: Deliver me, O Lord, from mine enemies
verses.second: for I flee unto thee to hide me.

verses.first: Teach me to do a thing that pleaſeth thee, for thou art my God
verses.second: let thy loving Spirit lead me forth into the land of righteouſneſs.

verses.first: Quicken me, O Lord, for thy Name’s ſake
verses.second: and for thy righteouſneſs ſake bring my ſoul out of trouble;

verses.first: And of thy goodneſs ſlay mine enemies
verses.second: and deſtroy all them that vex my ſoul, for I am thy ſervant.

verses.first: BLESSED be the Lord my ſtrength
verses.second: who teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight;

verses.first: My hope and my fortreſs, my caſtle and deliverer, my defender in whom I truſt
verses.second: who ſubdueth my people that is under me.

verses.first: Lord, what is man, that thou haſt ſuch reſpect unto him
verses.second: or the ſon of man, that thou ſo regardeſt him!

verses.first: Man is like a thing of nought
verses.second: his time paſſeth away like a ſhadow.

verses.first: Bow thy heavens, O Lord, and come down
verses.second: touch the mountains, and they ſhall ſmoke.

verses.first: Caſt forth thy lightning, and tear them
verses.second: ſhoot out thine arrows, and conſume them.

verses.first: Send down thine hand from above
verses.second: deliver me, and take me out of the great waters, from the hand of ſtrange children;

verses.first: Whoſe mouth talketh of vanity
verses.second: and their right hand is a right hand of wickedneſs.

verses.first: I will ſing a new ſong unto thee, O God
verses.second: and ſing praiſes unto thee upon a tenſtringed lute.

verses.first: Thou haſt given victory unto kings
verses.second: and haſt delivered David thy ſervant from the peril of the ſword.

verses.first: Save me, and deliver me from the hand of ſtrange children
verses.second: whoſe mouth talketh of vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of iniquity.

verses.first: That our ſons may grow up as the young plants
verses.second: and that our daughters may be as the poliſhed corners of the temple.

verses.first: That our garners may be full and plenteous with all manner of ſtore
verses.second: that our ſheep may bring forth thouſands, and ten thouſands in our ſtreets.

verses.first: That our oxen may be ſtrong to labour, that there be no decay
verses.second: no leading into captivity, and no complaining in our ſtreets.

verses.first: Happy are the people that are in ſuch a caſe
verses.second: yea, bleſſed are the people who have the Lord for their God.

verses.first: I Will magnify thee, O God, my King
verses.second: and I will praiſe thy Name for ever and ever.

verses.first: Every day will I give thanks unto thee
verses.second: and praiſe thy Name for ever and ever.

verses.first: Great is the Lord, and marvellous worthy to be praiſed
verses.second: there is no end of his greatneſs.

verses.first: One generation ſhall praiſe thy works unto another
verses.second: and declare thy power.

verses.first: As for me, I will be talking of thy worſhip
verses.second: thy glory, thy praiſe, and wondrous works;

verses.first: So that men ſhall ſpeak of the might of thy marvellous acts
verses.second: and I will alſo tell of thy greatneſs.

verses.first: The memorial of thine abundant kindneſs ſhall be ſhewed
verses.second: and men ſhall ſing of thy righteouſneſs.

verses.first: The Lord is gracious and merciful
verses.second: longſuffering and of great goodneſs.

verses.first: The Lord is loving unto every man
verses.second: and his mercy is over all his works.

verses.first: All thy works praiſe thee, O Lord
verses.second: and thy ſaints give thanks unto thee.

verses.first: They ſhew the glory of thy kingdom
verses.second: and talk of thy power;

verses.first: That thy power, thy glory, and mightineſs of thy kingdom
verses.second: might be known unto men.

verses.first: Thy kingdom is an everlaſting kingdom
verses.second: and thy dominion endureth throughout all ages.

verses.first: The Lord upholdeth all ſuch as fall
verses.second: and lifteth up all thoſe that are down.

verses.first: The eyes of all wait upon thee, O Lord
verses.second: and thou giveſt them their meat in due ſeaſon.

verses.first: Thou openeſt thine hand
verses.second: and filleſt all things living with plenteouſneſs.

verses.first: The Lord is righteous in all his ways
verses.second: and holy in all his works.

verses.first: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him
verses.second: yea, all ſuch as call upon him faithfully.

verses.first: He will fulfil the deſire of them that fear him
verses.second: he alſo will hear their cry, and will help them.

verses.first: The Lord preſerveth all them that love him
verses.second: but ſcattereth abroad all the ungodly.

verses.first: My mouth ſhall ſpeak the praiſe of the Lord
verses.second: and let all fleſh give thanks unto his holy Name for ever and ever.

verses.first: PRAISE the Lord, O my ſoul; while I live will I praiſe the Lord
verses.second: yea, as long as I have any being, I will ſing praiſes unto my God.

verses.first: O put not your truſt in princes, nor in any child of man
verses.second: for there is no help in them.

verses.first: For when the breath of man goeth forth, he ſhall turn again to his earth
verses.second: and then all his thoughts periſh.

verses.first: Bleſſed is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help
verses.second: and whoſe hope is in the Lord his God;

verses.first: Who made heaven and earth, the ſea, and all that therein is
verses.second: who keepeth his promiſe for ever;

verses.first: Who helpeth them to right that ſuffer wrong
verses.second: who feedeth the hungry.

verses.first: The Lord looſeth men out of priſon
verses.second: the Lord giveth ſight to the blind.

verses.first: The Lord helpeth them that are fallen
verses.second: the Lord careth for the righteous.

verses.first: The Lord careth for the ſtrangers, he defendeth the fatherleſs and widow
verses.second: as for the way of the ungodly, he turneth it upſide down.

verses.first: The Lord thy God, O Sion, ſhall be King for evermore
verses.second: and throughout all generations.

verses.first: O Praiſe the Lord, for it is a good thing to ſing praiſes unto our God
verses.second: yea, a joyful and pleaſant thing it is to be thankful.

verses.first: The Lord doth build up Jeruſalem
verses.second: and gather together the out-caſts of Iſrael.

verses.first: He healeth thoſe that are broken in heart
verses.second: and giveth medicine to heal their ſickneſs.

verses.first: He telleth the number of the ſtars
verses.second: and calleth them all by their names.

verses.first: Great is our Lord, and great is his power
verses.second: yea, and his wiſdom is infinite.

verses.first: The Lord ſetteth up the meek
verses.second: and bringeth the ungodly down to the ground.

verses.first: O ſing unto the Lord with thankſgiving
verses.second: ſing praiſes upon the harp unto our God;

verses.first: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, and prepareth rain for the earth
verses.second: and maketh the graſs to grow upon the mountains, and herb for the uſe of men;

verses.first: Who giveth fodder unto the cattle
verses.second: and feedeth the young ravens that call upon him.

verses.first: He hath no pleaſure in the ſtrength of an horſe
verses.second: neither delighteth he in any man’s legs.

verses.first: But the Lord’s delight is in them that fear him
verses.second: and put their truſt in his mercy.

verses.first: Praiſe the Lord, O Jeruſalem
verses.second: praiſe thy God, O Sion.

verses.first: For he hath made faſt the bars of thy gates
verses.second: and hath bleſſed thy children within thee.

verses.first: He maketh peace in thy borders
verses.second: and filleth thee with the flower of wheat.

verses.first: He ſendeth forth his commandment upon earth
verses.second: and his word runneth very ſwiftly.

verses.first: He giveth ſnow like wool
verses.second: and ſcattereth the hoar-froſt like aſhes.

verses.first: He caſteth forth his ice like morſels
verses.second: who is able to abide his froſt?

verses.first: He ſendeth out his word, and melteth them
verses.second: he bloweth with his wind, and the waters flow.

verses.first: He ſheweth his word unto Jacob
verses.second: his ſtatutes and ordinances unto Iſrael.

verses.first: He hath not dealt ſo with any nation
verses.second: neither have the heathen knowledge of his laws.

verses.first: O Praiſe the Lord of heaven
verses.second: praiſe him in the height.

verses.first: Praiſe him, all ye angels of his
verses.second: praiſe him, all his hoſt.

verses.first: Praiſe him, ſun and moon
verses.second: praiſe him, all ye ſtars and light.

verses.first: Praiſe him, all ye heavens
verses.second: and ye waters that are above the heavens.

verses.first: Let them praiſe the Name of the Lord
verses.second: for he ſpake the word, and they were made; he commanded, and they were created.

verses.first: He hath made them faſt for ever and ever
verses.second: he hath given them a law which ſhall not be broken.

verses.first: Praiſe the Lord upon earth
verses.second: ye dragons, and all deeps;

verses.first: Fire and hail, ſnow and vapours
verses.second: wind and ſtorm, fulfilling his word;

verses.first: Mountains and all hills
verses.second: fruitful trees and all cedars;

verses.first: Beaſts and all cattle
verses.second: worms and feathered fowls;

verses.first: Kings of the earth and all people
verses.second: princes, and all judges of the world;

verses.first: Young men and maidens, old men and children, praiſe the Name of the Lord
verses.second: for his Name only is excellent, and his praiſe above heaven and earth.

verses.first: He ſhalt exalt the horn of his people; all his ſaints ſhall praiſe him
verses.second: even the children of Iſrael, even the people the ſerveth him.

verses.first: O Sing unto the Lord a new ſong
verses.second: let the congregation of ſaints praiſe him.

verses.first: Let Iſrael rejoice in him that made him
verses.second: and let the children of Sion be joyful in their King.

verses.first: Let them praiſe his Name in the dance
verses.second: let them ſing praiſes unto him with tabret and harp.

verses.first: For the Lord hath pleaſure in his people
verses.second: and helpeth the meek-hearted.

verses.first: Let the ſaints be joyful with glory
verses.second: let them rejoice in their beds.

verses.first: Let the praiſes of God be in their mouth
verses.second: and a two-edged ſword in their hands;

verses.first: To be avenged of the heathen
verses.second: and to rebuke the people;

verses.first: To bind their kings in chains
verses.second: and their nobles with links of iron.

verses.first: That they may be avenged of them, as it is written
verses.second: Such honour have all his ſaints.

verses.first: O Praiſe God in his holineſs
verses.second: praiſe him in the firmament of his power.

verses.first: Praiſe him in his noble acts
verses.second: praiſe him according to his excellent greatneſs.

verses.first: Praiſe him in the ſound of the trumpet
verses.second: praiſe him upon the lute and harp.

verses.first: Praiſe him in the cymbals and dances
verses.second: praiſe him upon the ſtrings and pipe.

verses.first: Praiſe him upon the well-tuned cymbals
verses.second: praiſe him upon the loud cymbals.

verses.first: Let every thing that hath breath
verses.second: praiſe the Lord.
